articleTitle: AES Efficient Encryption of Multimedia Data using Threads for 5G System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: As technology advances, encryption methods must adapt to protect sensitive information. Organizations must stay informed about emerging threats and regularly update their protocols to stay ahead. Investing in advanced encryption technologies can mitigate potential breaches. Encryption protects intellectual property, multimedia data, and personal data from cyber threats, a crucial consideration for businesses and individuals in the digital age. This work introduces four AES-based threads for encrypting and decoding multimedia data in 5G. Both sequential and parallel methods have been used for data security. Furthermore, time analyses for sequential and parallel processing algorithms have been conducted using images of various sizes and formats. The results indicate that the encryption process will be completed faster and will provide network-wide data safety in parallel method.

articleTitle: AI-Integrated Sensor Data Analytics for Real-Time Decision-Making in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The study compares the performance of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) with 20, 30, 40, and 50 nodes in real-time AI-enhanced sensor analytics using the AODV routing protocol. All configurations showed a consistent Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) of 100%. However, the end-to-end delay increased slightly from 0.2 sec (20 nodes) to 0.3 sec (30, 40, 50 nodes), indicating that larger networks result in longer paths. Throughput decreased from 2560 bps at 20 nodes to 1706.67 bps in larger configurations, probable due to network congestion. Energy efficiency also decreased as the number of nodes increased, suggesting higher energy consumption per transmission.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Learning: The Role of AR/VR Technologies in Educational Delivery and Student Engagement in Higher Studies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) are emerging technologies that combine digital and physical worlds to provide immersive and interactive experiences. Their use in education has been revolutionary, particularly in terms of increasing student engagement, grasp of complicated concepts, and encouraging experiential learning. AR superimposes virtual things on real-world surroundings, whereas VR immerses viewers in a completely digital environment. These tools gained traction during the COVID-19 epidemic, demonstrating their potential for remote learning and increasing student enthusiasm and information retention. While AR and VR are commonly employed in higher education, particularly in sectors such as healthcare and engineering, there are still barriers to their complete adoption, including cost, accessibility, and ethical concerns. This study explores the impactful uses of AR and VR in education, shedding light on their potential to modernize traditional teaching methods and improve student outcomes.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Assessment of Fuzzy Rule-based Systems for Heart Attack Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Heart disease is a leading global cause of death, highlighting the need for accurate and efficient risk assessment methods. Traditional models often fail to address the uncertainty and vagueness in medical data. A Fuzzy Rule-Based System (FRBS) offers a solution by leveraging fuzzy logic to handle imprecise inputs like age, blood pressure, and lifestyle factors. The system uses fuzzification to convert crisp inputs into fuzzy sets, applies expert-defined IF-THEN rules through an inference engine, and translates outputs into interpretable risk scores via defuzzification. FRBS provides a flexible and patient-centric approach, accommodating linguistic variables and ambiguous data. Applications include real-time monitoring through wearable devices and telemedicine platforms, enhancing preventive care and empowering early detection of heart disease. This innovative system bridges the gap between medical uncertainty and actionable insights, improving healthcare

articleTitle: Improving Cancer Classification Through an Deep Learning Framework Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The primary objective of this work is to create an AI system that offers intelligible and transparent justifications for cancer classification. When it comes to medical imaging-based cancer detection, sophisticated image analysis techniques such as deep learning models are used to assess and interpret medical pictures while offering a transparent account of its reasoning. The performance of the three state-of-art pre-trained deep models: VGG-16, and EfficientNetB0 on a dataset of eight different cancer types obtained from Kaggle is analyzed in this work. Furthermore, a novel deep learning framework is proposed using the above mentioned three pre-trained models as the backbone network using transfer learning approach for each type of cancer. Each model's effectiveness is evaluated in classifying these cancers using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. This work ultimately yields the best fit model that are tuned with the hyper parameters optimized using Powell's algorithm.

articleTitle: Poverty Mapping with Satellite Vision for Social Good Using R-CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Poverty mapping using satellite imagery data has appeared as a revolutionary methodology for addressing challenges related to socio-economic in underserved areas. This idea influences the deep learning models, particularly R-CNNs (Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks) for examining high-quality satellite imagery and extracting features that represent poverty levels like agricultural patterns, urbanization, and infrastructure quality. By combining advanced image processing methods and geospatial datasets, this proposed algorithm detects the level of poverty with better accuracy requiring the least ground survey data. This proposed solution not only allows organizations and policymakers to allot resources more effectively, enhancing life's quality and driving sustainable growth in poor communities but also provides scalable and cost-effective alternatives for traditional techniques. The ability of this model generates comprehensive poverty mapping that empowers NGOs (Non-Government Organizations), government, and policymakers with actionable visions towards resource allocation effectively and prioritizes growth interventions. The model, which builds on a modified ResNet50 (Residual Network) framework, attained an R2 value of 93% and a low MAE (Mean Absolute Error) of 13%, showing its ability to map poverty patterns effectively.

articleTitle: Power Metric Based BBR Congestion Control Using XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Congestion is a prevalent challenge to every networks today due to the higher network access and inefficient utilization of available bandwidth. Bottleneck Bandwidth and Round-trip propagation time (BBR) is a popular congestion control algorithm introduced by Google. BBR estimates maximum bottleneck bandwidth and minimum propagation delay at end devices periodically to regulate the sending rate. However, there are still limitations exist due to the control parameter (called pacing gain value) used in the sending rate calculation. Since the pacing gain values used in different phases of BBR are fixed, there is an overestimation of the sending rate as well as inflight data. Thus, there is a persistent bottleneck queue formation and experiences higher network delay. In order to resolve the problem, we proposed a pacing gain prediction algorithm using XGBoost regression algorithm controlled by the power metric. The proposed algorithm adaptively predicts the pacing gain values with respect to the network parameters. The research focuses on multimedia applications, emphasizing the importance of reducing network delay to enhance Quality of Service (QoS). The proposed model achieves performance improvement than the existing regression models.

articleTitle: SmartGrid EV: Efficient Charging and Energy Harvesting System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The need for charging stations has significantly increased as a result of this project's advancement, making the creation of effective and sustainable charging solutions necessary. This project offers a cutting-edge charging station prototype made to support sustainable energy practices and satisfy the expanding demands of EV consumers. In addition to charging electric cars, the suggested system uses a dual power supply technique that transforms surplus energy into an AC supply for wider community usage. The charging station guarantees peak performance and energy efficiency by using a micro controller chip for accurate control and monitoring. The method supports grid stability and energy sustainability by allowing excess energy to be reinjected into the grid after EV batteries are completely charged. In order to promote a more environmentally friendly transportation future, this project intends to improve the usefulness of charging stations, encourage the incorporation of renewable energy sources, and offer a dependable infrastructure for electric cars.

articleTitle: Improving Software Defects Detection: An In-Depth Analysis of Machine Learning Methods and Static Analysis Tools for Greater Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Enhancing software quality and reducing testing expenses requires better software fault detection. To guarantee the dependability and usability of software, Software Defect Prediction (SDP) uses machine learning approaches to anticipate and address any problems early in the development cycle. Numerous machine learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Decision Stump, J48, Lazy IBK, and ZeroR, are thoroughly examined in this work. With an emphasis on feature selection as a crucial step in increasing prediction accuracy and lower computing costs, these approaches are assessed for their capacity to detect software flaws precisely. This research study demonstrates how these models may improve fault identification and prevention procedures using historical records from sources such as the PROMISE repository. The study highlights the best practices for machine learning-based software quality assurance, lowering expenses while guaranteeing superior results.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Two-Stage Cascaded Boost Converter Using IBGO-PI Algorithm for DC Drives
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The increasing power conversion in electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy systems and industrial automation demands leads to the need for more powerful solutions. In this paper, ITAE-Based Gain Optimization Algorithm (IBGO) and PI-Based (IBGO-PI) for the tuning of proportional (Kp) and Integral (Ki) gains in a Two-Stage Cascaded Boost Converter (TSCBC) running on DC motor is demonstrated. System modeling, combined with stability criterion analysis and integral time absolute error (ITAE) based fine-tuning in a feedback loop (the IBGO-PI algorithm) leads to improved performance of the system. This includes deriving the mathematical model of TSCBC and validating it against MATLAB simulation for the initial step in open loop configuration that's consistent with theoretical expectation but not for motor speed and torque performance suboptimality. The IBGO-PI algorithm is utilized to tune the PI controller gains and subsequently executed in the closed loop. The simulation results show substantial enhancement to the closed loop results for input/output voltages, currents, and motor speed and torque. This shows the IBGO-PI algorithm is capable of performance and reliability enhancement of TSCBC systems in application to high-performance DC drives.

articleTitle: IoT Based Varicose Vein Diagnosis System and Therapy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Varicose veins are common among old age people. Varicose veins are inflamed and tangled veins on the legs. Blood is carried from the heart to the body via arteries, with veins returning blood to the heart, necessitating the return of blood from the legs against gravitational forces. Damage to vein valves leads to varicose veins, a condition linked to factors such as overweight, lack of exercise, hormonal fluctuations during pregnancy, and prolonged standing. This condition can cause significant discomfort and pain. Massage and exercise are effective in improving blood flow and alleviating symptoms. This project proposes the constant monitoring of physiological conditions using sensor technology and the alleviation of symptoms through vibration and cooling therapy. The integration of heart rate, SpO2, temperature, and muscle activity allows for the measurement of physiological indicators. This real-time analysis, facilitated through the Blynk app, enables symptom detection, and discomfort is alleviated and blood circulation is enhanced through controlled vibration and cooling therapy.

articleTitle: Thalaseemia Prediction Using Deep Neural Networks: A Step Towards Personalized Medicine
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Thalaseemia is a series of genetic hemolytic diseases brought on by defective hemoglobin synthesis. It is prevalent in many Asian, African, and Mediterranean nations. Four million Indians are Thalaseemia carriers, and more than 100,000 are actively combating the condition, according to the World Health Organization. It is specifically taken under investigation because cases of Thalassemia that have clinical, hematologic characteristics cannot be effectively separated from cases of sickle cell anemia and are misdiagnosed as such. The precise profiles of the genetic and pathophysiological mechanisms of patients with Thalassemia are not yet well defined, despite the fact that they are clinically treated identically. Even among people with the same genotype, there are differences in the severity of the clinical phenotype. The frequency of complications changes over time, both within and between individuals. Patients display a striking variation in severity, from a milder clinical course to severe transfusion dependency and progressive organ destruction. This study focuses on the creation of a discriminative model for Thalaseemia classification. In this study, the prediction of Thalassemia is modeled as a pattern classification issue, and the models are constructed using deep learning approaches. The hybrid CNN-Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) based Thalaseemia prediction model has demonstrated improved performance, according to the performance evaluation of these models.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique for Image-Based Bladder Cancer Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Bladder cancer represents a significant global health challenge. Recent advances in deep learning (DL) have shown promise in enhancing bladder cancer (BC) detection and diagnosis through improved image analysis and pattern recognition capabilities. This review emphasizes current research on the application of DL methods in BC detection, emphasizing the diverse technique, dataset, and performance metrics employed across studies. DL, particularly convolutional neural network (CNN), has been extensively utilized for processing medical data such as CT, MRI, and cystoscopy images. These models have demonstrated high accuracy in identifying bladder tumors, often surpassing traditional machine learning (ML) approaches. Key methodologies reviewed include data preprocessing techniques, model architectures, and strategies for addressing class imbalances, which are critical in medical datasets. The review further discusses the importance of external validation and the integration of advanced techniques like transfer learning and hybrid models to bolster performance. Future research directions focus on overcoming current limitations by leveraging multi-modal data, improving interpretability, and refining model training processes to ensure reliable clinical application.

articleTitle: Integrating Explainable Machine Learning (XAI) in Stroke Medicine: Opportunities and Challenges for Early Diagnosis and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Stroke is a leading cause of mortality and disability worldwide, emphasizing the critical need for early diagnosis and prevention. Machine learning (ML) has demonstrated significant potential in improving stroke prediction and management by analysing complex datasets for risk stratification, diagnosis, and treatment planning. However, the adoption of ML in stroke medicine is limited by the opacity of these models, which can hinder clinical trust and decision-making. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) addresses this challenge by making ML models more interpretable and transparent, enabling healthcare professionals to understand, validate, and trust their outputs. This research work explores the integration of XAI in stroke medicine, highlighting its potential to enhance early diagnosis, personalized prevention strategies, and treatment planning. We discuss the opportunities XAI provides in identifying high-risk patients, uncovering critical predictors, and enabling informed clinical decisions. Furthermore, we examine challenges such as ensuring model reliability, addressing biases in stroke datasets, and navigating ethical considerations related to patient data privacy and algorithmic accountability.

articleTitle: Agricultural Unmanned Airboat: A Control Systems Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This research develops and tests a maneuverability model for an unmanned agricultural airboat designed for autonomous operations in fields such as paddy and arecanut plantations. The airboat follows a predefined row-by-row path, enabling precise navigation using a Raspberry Pi. By automating tasks such as pesticide spraying, the system reduces labor costs and improves operational efficiency. The accurate modeling of maneuverability ensures crop safety while navigating diverse agricultural terrains, offering a sustainable and efficient solution for modern farming practices.

articleTitle: The Role of Bio Informatics in Identifying Cancer Informatics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the advent of bioinformatics, cancer research has entered a new age wherein vast amounts of complex biological data can be interpreted to create powerful treatments. This approach has exceptionally improved the identification of biomarkers, deciphering hidden patterns contained within data, and developing personalized treatment modalities by incorporating bioinformatics-based strategies with artificial intelligence and machine learning. Advances in bioinformatics will soon give insight into the cancer process at cellular levels and offer a better understanding of tumor heterogeneity and evolution. Increased reliance on bioinformatics has directly affected the development of newer immunotherapy forms. In the last year, there have been 13 new FDA-approved immunotherapy treatments for 10 different drugs and 11 types of cancers specific to each one. The future of bioinformatics in cancer research is bright, and the field is likely to be further revolutionized with the continued progress in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and single-cell analysis techniques

articleTitle: AI-Driven Transcription and Analysis for Medical Conversations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This paper presents an advanced system that integrates Google's Speech Recognition API with the Gemini-l.5-flash model to improve audio processing and response generation, particularly in the context of healthcare communication. The system is designed to transcribe audio files of doctor-patient conversations accurately and generate contextually relevant responses using AI. A user-friendly interface, developed with Tkinter, allows seamless uploading and processing of these audio files. The integration of these technologies aims to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of automated response systems, thereby improving patient-provider communication. The system's capabilities were evaluated using real-world healthcare datasets, demonstrating its potential to streamline the workflow from audio input to meaningful textual output. This work not only showcases the practical application of AI in healthcare but also lays the groundwork for future innovations in automated medical communication systems.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to High-Reliability Data Transmission System for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The work presents a hybrid communication system for highly reliable data transmission for unmanned surface vessels (USVs) operating in challenging maritime environments. The proposed system integrates adaptive channel switching, data compression and device reconfiguration to overcome interference problems and ensure uninterrupted transmission of video, telemetry and control signals. Trials have demonstrated system stability at 80% packet loss, enabling real-time operations including environmental monitoring and search and rescue. The research highlights the robustness of the system under a range of operating conditions and suggests potential applications in both commercial and dual-use sectors.

articleTitle: Early Chronic Kidney Disease Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is an important public health issue, affecting millions globally. Early identification is important to intervene in time and manage the disease effectively. In this study, the potential for using machine learning methods, such as the Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) algorithm, is investigated for developing predictive models of CKD risk prediction from clinical and demographic indicators. LightGBM proves to be effective in processing large datasets with multiple features and thus is apt for this analysis. The model is able to predict the risk of CKD using patient-specific features like age, blood pressure, and laboratory findings, enabling early screening and targeted intervention. Comparative performance evaluation against other machine learning models like K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Decision Trees establishes the advantage of LightGBM. The model reaches 96% accuracy, 93% recall, and an F1-score of 89%, demonstrating the reliability of the model for CKD prediction. The research also pinpoints significant risk factors affecting CKD, providing important information for future research and clinical use. The results highlight the capability of machine learning to improve early detection of CKD and better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: RF Technology for Automatic Vehicle Speed Control and Regulation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The RF transmitter and receiver units are the two main components of the system. In this configuration, RF signals including information on the speed limit are broadcast by the transmitter unit, which will be situated within the designated speed zones. These sent RF signals will be picked up by a receiving unit mounted in a car, which will then process them further using an Arduino Uno microcontroller. By using the motor driver circuit, it will automatically control the vehicle's speed based on the input of the speed limit. The car and speed zone indicators can communicate in real time thanks to this RF technology-based project. Better adherence to speed restrictions, increased road safety, and better traffic management will follow from this. An LCD will be a part of the system.

articleTitle: Computer Vision and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for Advanced Face Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Modern security and law enforcement involve face detection and recognition technologies, which are crucial instruments in criminal identification. It is a comprehensive system integrating advanced face detection algorithms and robust recognition techniques with a view of providing accurate and efficient identification of an individual relating to a criminal activity. It uses the latest CNNs technology for automatic extraction of facial features, matching, and classification, with an advanced algorithm for the matching that compares all identified faces to a database of criminal individuals. Its large processing databases improve the identification speed rate with fewer false positives or negatives. Other issues the paper deals with are lighting conditions, facial expression, etc.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Social Media Data Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Social media platforms, such as YouTube, generate an extensive amount of unstructured data, offering valuable insights into user behavior, engagement patterns, and preferences. This project focuses on predictive analysis of YouTube data using a hybrid machine learning framework. Various video metadata, including descriptions, titles, tags, views, likes, and comments, are analyzed to forecast audience engagement and trends. The pipeline begins with data preprocessing, including handling missing values, removing duplicates, and preparing the data for analysis. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) is performed to uncover hidden patterns and relationships, followed by feature selection techniques to identify the most influential variables. The dataset is then split into training and testing subsets, and advanced machine learning models are employed to predict video performance and user engagement. The results are evaluated using key performance metrics, delivering actionable insights to improve content strategies and audience targeting. This study highlights the effectiveness of machine learning techniques in optimizing YouTube content and enhancing decision-making in digital marketing.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Machine Learning Model for Osteoporosis Risk Prediction from Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The metabolic condition osteoporosis afflicted a large number of people worldwide. Osteoporosis causes major health and its financial implications worldwide. However, the advancement of osteoporosis-related methods for forecasting is inadequate. Machine Learning (ML), a subfield of Artificial Intelligence (AI)I allows computers to ‘learn’ using programs. In comparison to classic statistical methods, ML places a greater focus on prediction accuracy and can find patterns in multidimensional data sets. This study propose an ensemble model employing Random Forest(RF), XGBoost(XGB) and Light Gradient Boosting(LGBM) techniques for the prediction of osteoporosis from the medical data of an individual. The accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score were computed to compare the model with four alternative machine learning models: Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN). The findings show that the ensemble model outperforms with an accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score of 93.5%, 92.8%, 94.2% and 93.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Prediction with Suitable Fertilization Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Crop yield prediction and fertilizer recommendation are critical for enhancing agricultural productivity and resource efficiency. This research presents a machine learning-based system utilizing advanced algorithms, including Decision Tree, LightGBM, XGBoost, AdaBoost, Random Forest, ExtraTree, Gradient Boosting, and Bagging Classifier, to forecast agricultural production based on key agricultural parameters. The ExtraTree model achieved an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 99.4% for yield prediction, while ensemble methods like Stacking and Voting Classifiers reached 100% accuracy in fertilizer recommendations using soil and crop data. A Flask-based interface with SQLite authentication was developed for real-time predictions, allowing users to input data and receive actionable insights. This scalable solution integrates machine learning with practical agriculture, helping farmers optimize crop management, adopt sustainable practices, and contribute to global food security.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Adaptive Signal Processing for Low-Power Edge Devices in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a transformative approach to adaptive signal processing on low-power edge devices operating in dynamic environments. This work introduces an RL-driven framework utilizing Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in conjunction with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to autonomously enhance signal quality and reduce energy consumption. The model dynamically adjusts to fluctuating noise and interference by fine-tuning filtering techniques, optimizing compression, and adapting hardware configurations. Tests on platforms like NVIDIA Jetson Nano and Raspberry Pi show a 12% improvement in signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and a 25% reduction in power consumption compared to baseline methods, showcasing RL's potential for real-time, energy-efficient edge processing. Future applications of this framework could extend to larger IoT networks, employing federated learning for distributed optimization across interconnected low-power devices.

articleTitle: Development of EEG-Based Prosthetic Limb for Paraplegic and Quadriplegic Patients
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Paraplegic and quadriplegic patients and amputees face severe difficulties in performing their daily activities. A viable and effective solution for this is the development of prosthetic limbs that enable them to carry out their everyday chores. In this work, a model is proposed for electroencephalograph (EEG)-based control of these prosthetic limbs. The study compares a multi-layer perceptron and support vector machine based models for movement classification based on EEG waveforms. The raw EEG signals were obtained from the open source Kaggle website. The signals were then preprocessed, followed by data splitting, model training and evaluation, visualization and final support vector machine (SVM)-based classification. The performance of the model was evaluated based on the following metrics: precision, recall, F1-score and accuracy. The proposed SVM-based model achieved an overall accuracy of 86%. The proposed model shows great promise in developing a complete brain computer interface for controlling the prosthetic limbs. The future scope of the study entails improving the accuracy of the developed model by incorporating techniques like data augmentation and ensemble learning.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Traditional Natural Language Processing Methods for Emotion Recognition Using Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Emotion Recognition plays an important role in recognizing human behavior. Human behavior may be represented in text, speech, and facial expressions. In traditional form, natural language processing known as NLP is used to extract features to evaluate emotions. With the evolution of Quantum Computing, Quantum Machine learning often called QML is one of the research areas used to evaluate emotions. This paper is designed to compare traditional ML models with QML models to analyze the sentiments and emotions of multimodal data. Here, NLP techniques are used for preprocessing. A hybrid model is built by combining NLP and QML. The preprocessed data are transmitted into quantum circuits for computation, and its results are compared with conventional machine learning models. This evaluation identifies QML as a promising future as it is useful for large and complex data sets with high dimensions. This study highlights the potential of QML in NLP and outlines the challenges such as encoding and hardware limitations.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Binocular Vision Optimization for Enhanced 3D Reconstruction of IP Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: As an important branch of machine learning, 3D reconstruction algorithms are widely used in visual reconstruction tasks. To overcome the limitations of traditional 3D reconstruction methods in terms of parameter set, inference speed and accuracy, this study proposes a new 3D reconstruction model based on binocular vision optimization algorithm. As a specific scenario, the algorithm is applied to the processing of complex scenes in IP images. The proposed model first combines the prior knowledge of image shape and models it by elliptical feature point sampling and grid multi-homography estimation. This operation can achieve efficient disparity computation; then, the study uses deep learning to optimize the binocular matching algorithm. The algorithm accurately predicts the disparity value through the stacked cost volume construction technology. At the same time, as an algorithm optimization, this study optimizes the reconstruction algorithm based on the optimization strategy of PatchMatch and further reduces the computational complexity. The experiment uses a self-constructed image dataset to verify the performance of the model in various scenarios. The experiment shows that the proposed algorithm has significant advantages in the accuracy and efficiency of 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: VisioLingua: IVIS (Intelligent Vision Interpretation System)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Visually impaired individuals face significant challenges in accessing textual and Braille-based information, limiting their independence and engagement with the world. To address these issues, this work introduces an innovative assistive system that combines machine learning, computer vision, and text-to-speech technologies. This paper discusses the design and implementation of a system that enables real-time recognition and processing of printed text and Braille characters, converting them into audible speech for immediate use. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) powered by TensorFlow and Keras ensure high accuracy in Braille character recognition. At the same time, OpenCV handles crucial image preprocessing steps such as grayscale conversion, thresholding, and contour detection. Text recognition is facilitated through Tesseract OCR, and the pyttsx3 library provides efficient multilingual text-to-speech conversion. Compact and user-friendly, the system has the potential to significantly improve the quality of life for visually impaired individuals by fostering independence and inclusivity.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Worker Safety and Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The system ensures worker safety in hazardous environments like mines through real-time monitoring using NodeMCU. It incorporates sensors such as MQ7 for detecting carbon monoxide, MQ135 for carbon dioxide and other harmful gases, and DHT22 for temperature and humidity. With an accuracy of 97%, the system delivers reliable performance in 90% of typical conditions. The NodeMCU's built-in Wi-Fi facilitates efficient data transmission to a mobile app, maintaining real-time updates with minimal delays of 1–3 %. Under normal conditions, workers can carry out tasks without concern, but when hazardous gases or unsafe temperatures are detected, the system sends instant alerts to the app, enabling prompt corrective actions. This advanced monitoring solution provides effective safety measures, ensuring both protection and operational efficiency in high-risk workplaces. Its seamless operation and proactive alert system make it a dependable tool for safeguarding workers' well-being

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Solar Powered KY Converter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This research examines the superiority of a KY converter powered by solar energy. The investigation is conducted in two phases. Firstly, the KY converter functions in an open-loop configuration with different duty cycles, and the agreeing output results are evaluated to validate the voltage equation of the KY converter. Finally, a closed-loop control configuration is employed by scheming a Proportional-Integral (PI) controller. The regulation of the PI controller parameters is amended using the Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) to improve voltage regulation. The MATLAB simulation results authenticate the superiority of the GOA-based PI regulator in attaining stable and ripple free voltage regulation under dynamic operating conditions. The proposed GOA is compared with traditional algorithms and the analysis validates the superiority of the projected optimization technique. The findings of this research work such as ripple free output voltage and output current provide valuable insights into the integration of KY converters in solar energy applications. The presented work underwrites to the progression of optimized power converters for solar energy systems, confirming unchanging and efficient power transfer.

articleTitle: VirtualMe: A Large Language Model-Powered Chatbot for Enhanced Human Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The VirtualMe Chat-Bot exploits the capabilities of advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) to offer users a smooth, automatic interface for interacting with their computers using natural language. This chat-bot enables users to execute a diverse range of tasks, from basic system commands to complex, application-specific actions and dynamic web interactions, all through simple conversational input. By allowing users to communicate with their computers in a natural and efficient way, VirtualMe aims to enhance user productivity, accessibility, and overall experience in computing. The system integrates both free and open-source technologies, including the Mistral 7B Instruct model and various natural language processing tools such as Hugging Face Transformers and prompt generators, along with the paid GPT-4 model from OpenAI. By applying these LLMs allows VirtualMe to interpret and respond to user requests accurately, facilitating everything from routine commands to task automation. By utilizing Python's versatile programming ecosystem, the system delivers a powerful, cost-effective solution that meets the diverse needs of modern users, from casual interactions to professional applications. This robust approach encourages innovation in human-computer interaction and opens new possibilities for automating daily tasks, setting a new standard for productivity and accessibility in computing. The application stands as a forward-thinking solution, uniting open-source advancements and cutting-edge LLMs to transform the way users interact with technology in their everyday lives.

articleTitle: Sustainable Traffic Optimization for Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This study examined the effects of different factors on CO2. We looked at Ahmedabad's emissions between 2021 and 2024. Factors such as vehicle types recorded CO2 emissions, fuel economy, traffic control effectiveness, energy consumption from renewable and fossil fuels, per capita energy consumption, and urban population increase. The data was analyzed using Multivariate Linear Regression, Fisher's Skewness test, and Jarque-Bara test for Kurtosis. The results show a significant negative correlation between CO2 emissions and the effectiveness of traffic management, suggesting that better traffic systems and less congestion may reduce emissions. The close association between rising CO2 emissions and urban population growth highlights the need for sustainable urban mobility systems. The use of clean energy in urban transit systems is encouraged by the finding that employing renewable energy in public transportation reduces emissions. There is a complex relationship between vehicle types and emissions, with different fuel types (such as gasoline, diesel, and electric) contributing differently to overall emissions. The primary sources of emissions in cities are traffic and vehicle energy use, making energy-efficient cars and eco-friendly modes of transportation essential.

articleTitle: Emerging Trends in Anomaly Detection for Surveillance Videos: Methods and Insights
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Anomaly detection in video surveillance is an advanced field garnering increasing attention from the research community due to its critical role in ensuring public security. The demand for intelligent systems capable of automatically detecting anomalous events in streaming videos has led to the development of numerous innovative approaches. Researchers have explored diverse domains of anomaly detection, including network anomaly detection, financial fraud detection, and human behavioral analysis. In the context of video surveillance, this survey synthesizes recent advancements in methodologies, datasets, and results while critically analyzing their limitations. Some of the methods that are emphasized are unified frameworks that combine pose, object, and motion features, weakly supervised spatio-temporal models, and hybrid architectures that use both graph neural networks and diffusion models. These methods have shown ability on benchmark datasets such as UCF-Crime, ShanghaiTech, and UCSD PED1, achieving high AUC scores and enhanced anomaly localization. However, challenges such as adaptability to dynamic environments, reliance on extensive datasets, and real-time processing constraints persist. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the state of the art, offering insights into existing gaps and future research directions to advance video anomaly detection technologies for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Pharmacy Management System using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Pharmacy Management System (PMS) is an advanced software solution designed to increase the efficiency, accuracy and safety of pharmaceutical operations. System automates important functions such as inventory management, prescription processing, billing and compliance tracking, thus enables spontaneous pharmacy operations and enhances patient care. With integration of upcoming technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing, and Barcode scanning, PMS reduces errors, eliminates stockouts, and increases drug safety. The system also includes real-time analytics and reporting, which enables decision making and adaptation to resource use. The upcoming technologies such as IoT-based intelligent inventory management and integration give the PMS in the event of changing the pharmacy management by ensuring enhancement of accessibility, streamlining operations and compliance. The project emphasizes the importance of digital change in modern healthcare, which has increased service distribution and improves the patient's satisfaction.

articleTitle: IoT-based Smart Milk Boiling Alert System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative Internet of Things (IoT) solution designed to revolutionize the conventional process of boiling milk by addressing manual monitoring challenges. Recognizing milk's rich source of essential nutrients, careful boiling is necessary to prevent spills and retain nutritional value. The proposed system integrates a strategically positioned LM35 temperature sensor near the milk container, ensuring continuous temperature monitoring. As the milk approaches its boiling point, the system triggers a mobile app alert, enabling users to turn off the gas stove remotely. This study incorporates a comprehensive literature review of various papers, underlining the importance of efficient milk boiling practices. The primary goal is to enhance convenience and safety, allowing users to multitask while ensuring an efficient milk boiling process. Leveraging an Arduino microcontroller, Bluetooth module, and Android app, this IoT-based system provides real-time monitoring and control. This technological innovation signifies a significant step towards efficient and environmentally responsible milk-boiling practices, addressing the evolving needs of modern households.

articleTitle: Towards Sustainable Cloud Computing: Innovations in Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The rapid expansion of cloud computing has significantly increased energy consumption in data centers, posing critical financial, operational, and environmental challenges. To address these issues, energy-efficient resource allocation has become a cornerstone for optimizing energy usage while ensuring high service quality and system reliability. This paper comprehensively analyzes state-of-the-art techniques, including dynamic workload management, predictive analytics for intelligent resource scheduling, and virtualization technologies tailored for multi-cloud and hybrid cloud environments. The transformative role of AI -driven algorithms and renewable energy integration is also examined, demonstrating their potential to drive sustainable and scalable cloud operations. Key tradeoffs between energy efficiency, performance, scalability, and cost are evaluated, offering actionable insights to practitioners and researchers. Furthermore, the paper highlights challenges such as computational overhead, policy compliance, and economic feasibility and proposes in-novative solutions for overcoming these barriers. This study outlines a roadmap for advancing greener, cost-effective cloud infrastructures that align with global sustainability goals by synthesizing recent advancements. Collaboration across industry, academia, and policymakers is emphasized to foster an ecosystem of environmentally responsible cloud computing solutions.

articleTitle: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Relational Mapping of Resume Data for Improved Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Analysis of resume data is often a critical and time-intensive process that requires extensive metadata. However, a lack of consistency and scalability often leads to inefficiencies and errors in the recruitment process. Tools like Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) often struggle with the contextual understanding of resume data, as they evaluate each resume in isolation without considering its relations to other similar resumes. We proposes the implementation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to create a vector relational mapping of resume data based on several curated parameters, such as skills, experiences, and education. This approach enables the system to understand the contextual relations between different resumes, helping the system evaluate them more effectively within a broader context, and improve recruitment outcomes by reducing biases and increasing efficiency.

articleTitle: Cuisine Connect: Personalized Recipe Recommender with Language Support
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cuisine Connect is an intelligent recipe recommendation system that transforms a simple list of user-provided ingredients into a curated selection of personalized recipes. It is designed to enhance the cooking experience for a beginner to cook, so that picking the precise ingredients for a recipe is essential, the system leverages advanced natural language processing (NLP) techniques to pre-process user inputs and efficiently match them with a comprehensive recipe database. Pre-processing steps such as stop word removal, stemming, and TF-IDF vectorization enable accurate ingredient matching and filtering. The backend, built entirely using Flask, ensures robust and seamless communication between the user interface and the recipe database. Cuisine Connect supports multilingual recipe instructions, empowering users to explore and follow diverse cuisines in their preferred language. This feature-rich system also incorporates efficient data scraping and pre-processing pipelines to maintain an up-to-date repository of recipes. By offering a user-friendly interface and real-time responses, Cuisine Connect bridges the gap between available ingredients and culinary creativity, encouraging users to experiment with new dishes as well as minimizing food waste.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Classification Using a Quad Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Skin cancer is a highly prevalent form of cancer that frequently arises from the proliferation of abnormal cells on the skin. Early detection is crucial for effective treatment and better prognosis. Traditional diagnostic methods face challenges in accuracy and timeliness, making automated techniques a valuable tool in disease identification. This article proposes a deep learning framework based on an ensemble, aimed at enhancing the detection and classification of various types of cancer on the skin. The approach integrates four optimized Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) using a weighted average ensemble technique. This model addresses common challenges in data preparation, model selection, and overfitting through comprehensive preprocessing and hyperparameter tuning, resulting in improved accuracy and robustness compared to existing systems.

articleTitle: Predicting Customer Purchase Intent Using Logistic Regression: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Predicting customer purchase intent is crucial for modern businesses in order to improve engagement, refine marketing strategies, and increase revenue. Conventional rule-based systems encounter difficulties with dynamic and extensive customer data, limiting their flexibility and precision. This project employs a machine learning methodology utilizing logistic regression to forecast customer intent based on demographic, transactional, and behavioral data. The proposed model analyses input features including age, browsing history, and previous purchases, employing sophisticated data preprocessing methods such as One-Hot Encoding and feature scaling to guarantee data integrity. Through hyperparameter tuning and the assessment of critical metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score, the system provides dependable and actionable insights. Real-time predictive capabilities enable businesses to customize customer interactions, facilitating targeted marketing and enhancing customer experience. This project underscores the capacity of predictive analytics to tackle real-world issues, facilitating data-driven decision-making and sustainable business development.

articleTitle: Novel Deep Learning Architecture for Automated Identification of Obstructive Sleep Apnea from Polysomnographic Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Sleep apnea disorder manifests as obstructive sleep apnea, which affects immense portions of society because it causes life-threatening health problems that include cardiovascular disease alongside diabetes and decreased productivity. The diagnosis of OSA through manual methods is both time demanding and expensive and contains a significant potential for human errors while requiring heavy resources. This research presents deep learning automation as the novel approach for automatic OSA detection through polysomnographic assessments. Our proposed system implements Genetics Algorithm optimized machine learning algorithms which include Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, Artificial Neural Networks and more. The analysis utilizes data from the Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset for preprocessing operations and features extraction that leads to better sleep disorder and stage classification accuracy. Through hyperparameter adjustment the Random Forest predictive model reached 95% F1 score which proved most effective for OSA detection. Through automation the classification process benefits from reliability with scalability and efficiency and produces better patient outcomes.

Author Keywords: Block Barcode for Sleep Disorder Diagnosis

articleTitle: Prediction of Liver Cirrhosis Disease by using XGBOOST Majority Voting Technique in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cirrhosis is a disease where chronic liver injury causes the liver to become extensively scarred. The liver's capacity to operate is compromised when healthy liver cells are replaced by scar tissue. Chronic infections with the hepatitis B (HBV) and hepatitis <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$C$</tex> (HCV) viruses are the primary causes of cirrhosis, which can develop from viral hepatitis to cirrhosis over a period of 10 to 20 years. Alcohol consumption is another significant risk factor for developing cirrhosis. Liver disease is becoming increasingly common in India, with one out of every five adults affected. Liver-related deaths in India contribute significantly to the global number of liver-related deaths, with 268,580 deaths annually, accounting for 18.3% of global liver-related mortality. Surface nodularity is an important imaging biomarker for detecting cirrhosis. It refers to irregularities in the surface texture of the liver that can be observed through imaging techniques such as ultrasound or CT scans. The XGBoost algorithm has been proposed as an effective tool for detecting liver tumours and classifying liver disease stages. Specifically, to increase its accuracy, XGBoost is used with the majority voting technique. The study compares XGBoost to a number of machine learning methods, such as Support Vector Machine, AdaBoost, K-nearest neighbour and Naive Bayes, XG Boost outperforms these algorithms, with the maximum accuracy of 99.4% in detecting liver tumours. Classifying the stages of liver disease can assist diagnosis and treatment recommendations. The effectiveness of early intervention can be increased by classifying the stages of liver disease using machine learning algorithms. Our work achieves state-of-the-art performance in liver disease categorization by combining the majority voting technique with an enhanced XGBoost algorithm. The model demonstrated great classification accuracy when tested and trained on a Kaggle dataset of liver diseases.

articleTitle: Predicting Carbon Dioxide Emissions from the Power Sector Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In growing countries like India, understanding and reducing environmental concerns requires accurate CO2 emission forecasts from the electricity sector. In order to forecast CO2 emissions from India's power industry, this research compares two models of artificial neural networks, namely the Modular Neural Network (MNN) and the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). Energy production, consumption trends, and environmental indicators are some of the historical data used in the study to train the models. The forecasting problem is divided into smaller sub-tasks using the Modular Neural Network technique, which enables specialized modules to handle unique data aspects. This improves efficiency and readability, especially for cases when the data distribution is nonlinear and heterogeneous. To test how well and how scalable the modular architecture is, we compare it to the MLP, a traditional feed forward neural network. Mean Average Percentage Error (MAPE), MSE, MAE, RMSE and correlation coefficient, are some of the important Performance metrics used to assess the models. The experimental results show that when it comes to capturing the complex dependencies in emission data, the MNN performs better than the MLP, leading to more accurate and dependable predictions. In order to back sustainable energy policy in India, this study presents a solid framework for predicting CO2 emissions and shows how neural networks can handle complicated environmental problems.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm-based Feature Selection Technique to Predict Diabetes in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Diabetes is a complex and lifelong disease that happens to someone with high blood glucose or blood sugar. The cause of Diabetes can be genetics, being overweight, and inactivity is a cause of Diabetes. If Diabetes is not in control, the patient must go to the doctor for a long time. However, machine learning approaches can reduce it. Therefore, in this paper, this paper executed seven classifiers to detect Diabetes. The classifiers are Random Forest, XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting), K Nearest Neighbor, Support Vector Machine, Neural Network, Naïve Bayes, and MOEFC (Multi-Objective Evolutionary Fuzzy Classifier) with two algorithms NSGA-II and ENORA. This paper used those classifiers and tried to optimize the accuracy. For optimization, this paper used some feature selection techniques. This paper used filter selection, wrapper, and recursive feature elimination approaches. Using the SVM classifier, this paper implemented cross-validation, which is k-fold, and got the highest accuracy of 77.6% using the SVM classifier. The features have been sorted according to their importance using the filter approach. This work achieved the highest accuracy of 79.87% from the filter approach using the SVM classifier. Also, it got the highest accuracy of 77.52% from the SVM classifier's wrapper approach. Then, by applying the recursive feature elimination approach, the research got the highest accuracy of 79.87% using the SVM classifier. Then, by applying MOEFC, the research got the highest accuracy of 83.043%. This work got the highest accuracy among all the processes by executing the MOEFC classifier, 83.043%, with four out of nine features using the genetic search approach of feature selection. This paper has been compared with some existing methods and is more accurate.

articleTitle: Enhanced Quality of Learning (QOL) via Secured Recommendation and Sentimental Analysis in Online Classes
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Nowadays online classes have become the main source of students learning. To achieve this, students' interaction is required. Basically, Cloud can provide more learning and interaction among the students and teachers (faculty). If teachers are good students are creating problem, if students are good and teachers are not so. To sort out all these things, complete monitoring is required. In case if a proper recommendation with guidance is provided then it will be easy for student to cope up and will be easy for the teachers to validate the students' progress. The proposed system provides a deep learning Recommender System knowing the capability of the students. Here, the quality of learning is enhanced by predicting the student/teacher's emotion via sentimental analysis. Recommender system is best for this. The proposed system also uses LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory Algorithm) to predict the students' activities and prefer recommendation according to their progress. This system helps student for developing their career and notice the teachers' activities for controlling the stress level of the students. By this way the students' creativity will increase and stress will be reduced. The system further provides more security with proper experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Real-Time Crawling of Customer Behavior Data and Marketing Strategy Optimization Based on Dynamic Graph Structure Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the continuous development of data mining and crawler algorithms, algorithm-based precision marketing has become a research trend in the computer+business field. With this background, this study proposes the real-time crawling of customer behavior data and marketing strategy optimization based on dynamic graph structure analysis. At the algorithm level, this study first designed a distributed crawler architecture. This efficient architecture uses Redis for URL deduplication and task allocation, and combines the Scrapy framework to achieve efficient data crawling. In the optimization part, the model ensures the uniqueness of crawled data by introducing a web page duplication detection module. Secondly, this study uses the HITS algorithm to analyze web page topics and identify authoritative pages and central pages. At the same time, the vector space model is combined to accurately capture the target data. After data acquisition, the LBSN (location-based social network) multi-mode heterogeneous network is integrated and analyzed, and community clustering analysis and shortest path optimization are performed simultaneously. This step uses the mutual information method to calculate the relevance of user interest topics, and discovers key nodes (Leader Nodes) through the depth-first search (DFS) algorithm. Finally, this study combined the K-means clustering algorithm to group and analyze user data and generate consumer portraits. The experimental part used the Men's mailing data-set for verification. The results showed that the proposed precision marketing model achieved significant results in increasing customer consumption, and the average reach rate exceeded the standard threshold of 90%.

articleTitle: Scalable Malicious URL Classification: Leveraging Lexical Analysis and API Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In the digital age, the proliferation of malicious Uniform Resource Locators(URLs) pose a significant cyber security threat, enabling phishing attacks, malware infections, and data breaches that risk sensitive information and user safety. Traditional methods using static blacklists and heuristics are ineffective against evolving threats. This study proposes a machine learning-based approach to enhance malicious URL detection, utilizing nine lexical features for efficient phishing attack identification. Leveraging the ISCXURL-2016 dataset, comprising 11,964 legitimate and phishing URLs, our model demonstrates effective detection capabilities suitable for resource constrained devices. The classification model accurately distinguishes between benign and malicious URLs by examining URL-derived features, metadata, and Application Program Interface(API) integration. This approach addresses the limitations of existing methods, which rely on numerous features requiring substantial processing power. The objective is to develop a dynamic, scalable system capable of identifying new, unseen malicious URLs with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Predicting Lung Cancer Risk and Early Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Using a healthcare dataset, this study applies a variety of ML techniques to analyze and forecast the likelihood of lung cancer. This dataset will be initialized by cleaning, encoding categorical variables, and removing duplicates to ensure quality and efficiency. Correlation analysis is carried out to find important characteristics that raise the risk of lung cancer. engineering including interaction terms enhances the predictive efficiency of the dataset. The various machine learning models are introduced they are Logistic Regression, SVC, Random Forests, GBM, and XGB. Over-sampling with ADASYN addresses class imbalance to improve model training. The logistic regression machine learning model has attained 97% accuracy. It will ensure consistency and reliability. Comprehensive visualizations such as heatmaps and bar plots, explore feature correlations and class distributions. The study represents the efficiency of ensemble methods like Random Forests and XGBoost, achieving superior predictive performance compared to baseline models. This system predicts whether they might have lung cancer, helping doctors to diagnose or early intervention.

articleTitle: Hotel Consumer Behavior Prediction Model Based on Facial Expression Recognition with Real-Time Cameras
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The intelligence of the hotel industry has gradually become an important research direction in the field of computeraided applications. To follow this trend, this study analyzes the hotel consumer behavior prediction model based on the facial expression recognition with real-time cameras. This study includes four core modules: (1) Real-time camera optimization. Use time-of-flight ToF technology to calibrate image distance to improve the accuracy of facial data collection; (2) High-precision face positioning. Use a multi-layer convolutional neural network combined with an offset analysis algorithm to achieve highly robust face detection and feature point extraction; (3) A new facial expression recognition algorithm. Calculate facial muscle deformation using the optical flow method and Cauchy tensor, and use the gated pruning algorithm to optimize the deep learning model to reduce computational complexity; (4) Consumer behavior prediction based on facial expression information. Use a dynamic matrix control algorithm to build a step response prediction model, and use the least squares method to optimize the system recognition accuracy. From the experimental results, it can be seen that the recognition accuracy of the proposed method in all expression categories is higher than that of SVM and KNN. Specifically, the highest accuracy of 98% is achieved in the “surprise” category in the smart hotel expression recognition scenario.

articleTitle: Combating Online Fraud: AI-Driven Fake Profile Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Since the vast platforms of social media having a wide range of users include a lot of scammers who claim to be genuine but are fake, so to eradicate these spammers it is essential to detect them first. Hence, a deep learning model has been built that detects these fake users. The model gathers a wide range of data from various social media platforms which include followers count, friends count, languages, location services and other valid parameters based on the platform where the user's profile is registered. All these parameters are typically analysed by different models and trained vigorously to find anomalies that account to fraudulent behaviour by the user. The classification of a user as fake or genuine is done using four different models namely Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and models of Recurrent Neural Networks like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM). Out of these ConvLSTM algorithm(model) used to detect real or fake profiles. In comparison, ConvLSTM topped the competition with a remarkable accuracy of 99.4% followed by LSTM and ANN around 99.3% and 99.1 % respectively whereas CNN had the least accuracy of 98% in detecting the imposters.

articleTitle: Sport Safety Enhancement: A Novel Approach with Monitoring Matrix-Based Image Acquisition and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the development of video array imaging technology, the accuracy and stability of video image acquisition have been improved. In this situation, this study proposes novel approach with monitoring matrix-based image acquisition and analysis for sport safety enhancement. This study includes the following four major innovations 1) Developed an image acquisition system based on a monitoring matrix, which can accurately capture the facial information of athletes through array imaging mode; 2) Proposed a new facial feature extraction algorithm, which realizes real-time analysis of facial images by fusing EAR and MAR features; 3) Proposed an improved expression recognition algorithm, and the improved activation function optimizes the expression recognition network to accurately identify the facial expressions of athletes; 4) Designed an image classification algorithm, and the 8 -pixel average mode is used for fuzzy information processing, so as to provide real-time warning information about the physical condition of athletes through the expression data. The experimental results show that the proposed method has satisfactory recognition accuracy on the Cambridge University Computer Laboratory's facial expression data set, and can accurately provide early warning of the athlete's status.

articleTitle: Advancements in Deepfake Detection: A Comprehensive Review of AI-Driven Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The significant developments in artificial neural network (ANN)-based technologies are crucial for manipulating multimedia content. Although technology has predominantly been used for purposes, such as education, some individuals have exploited it for unlawful or harmful activities. This literature review offers a comprehensive analysis of the advancements in deepfake detection. This study explores state-of-the-art approaches, including convolutional neural network (CNNs), transformers, ensemble model, and binary neural network, that leverage both spatial and temporal feature for effective detection. In addition, the review examines the role of data augmentation, artifact attention, and multi-modal analysis in enhancing detection accuracy across diverse datasets. By analyzing current methodologies and evaluating their strengths and limitations, this paper provides insights into the evolving landscape of deepfake detection by analyzing current methodologies and highlights key challenges such as the need for robust datasets and cross-domain generalization. Future directions are also outlined, emphasizing the potential of self-supervised learning, ensemble approaches, and advancements in artifact detection for more reliable and scalable solutions.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic-Driven ASIC Optimization for Neural Network Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) play a crucial role in accelerating neural network computations by providing optimized hardware tailored for specific tasks. However, achieving a balance between power consumption, processing speed, chip area, and thermal stability remains a challenge. This study introduces a fuzzy logic-driven approach to optimize ASIC performance for neural network acceleration. Using MATLAB's Fuzzy Toolbox, we define input variables such as power consumption, processing speed, chip area, and thermal stability, while the output variable represents the overall ASIC optimization score. The fuzzy inference system employs Mamdani-based rules to evaluate trade-offs among these parameters, ensuring an optimal balance between efficiency and hardware constraints. A set of 10 fuzzy rules is applied to determine the best configuration for maximizing performance while minimizing energy consumption and thermal effects. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed fuzzy logic model enhances ASIC efficiency by intelligently managing design constraints. This approach provides a scalable, adaptive solution for ASIC optimization, benefiting deep learning applications and next-generation AI accelerators.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithm System for Security Governance Driven by Big Data in Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the advancement of big data encryption and decryption technology, the role of data in national governance and social governance has become increasingly prominent. In order to effectively deal with the increasingly complex security governance issues, this study proposes the novel big data-driven intelligent algorithm system. The purpose of this study is to optimize the challenges of the network attack identification, protection measures, and encryption processing of information leakage in security governance through real-time monitoring and predictive analysis of data. The core of the designed system includes two modules: network attack detection algorithm and information leakage modeling encryption algorithm. From a methodological perspective, this study proposes a model for predicting abnormal network traffic based on chaos dynamics. This groundbreaking model uses time series analysis to identify and locate potential DDoS attack traffic. At the same time, combined with information entropy theory, a cascade network attack chain analysis model for DDoS attack protection is designed. At the data security level, an encryption algorithm based on chaos theory is used to effectively protect against information leakage. Through experimental verification, it is known that the proposed encryption algorithm can effectively retain the original data during the information encryption and decryption process. At the same time, through encryption algorithm verification, the security and anti-attack ability of information are improved.

articleTitle: Decentralization of Cloud Environment Using DES Technique in Medical Image
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cloud security is an important aspect in centralized data management in public resources. By increasing data processing and service access level, the integrity level be deformed due to data leakage, spoofing, and key leakages because of user behavioral approach to access the data is malpractice to own data. So the owner policy become unauthenticated to access the data rapidly increasing by non-authenticated users. To resolve this problem, propose a Service Level Integrity Proofing (SLIP) Verified Data Security. Based on Decentralized ChainLink Provable Advanced Encryption Standard (DCLP-AES) in Cloud Environment, this proposed system verifies each service access policy of user which is relatively posed to aggregate the owner certificate signing at chain-link verification. The verification can be time- stamped after the transaction is recorded into integrity weight. This proposed system improve the security levels based on integrity security signing level to protect the data compared to the other system as well high performance in security.

Author Keywords: Chain Link Encryption. Role Based Authentication

articleTitle: Rectangular Shaped High-Performance Textile UWB Antenna
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the advancement of wireless communication technologies, UWB is set to become the next generation of mobile communication systems. UWB (Ultra-Wide Band) technology is anticipated to play an essential part in advancing wireless networks. Above antenna is rectangular patch antenna that is designed to adopt to the ultra-wide frequency environments and adopt to the required conditions. The antenna that is designed above is resonates at 7.2 GHz at -16db. That shows that the antenna is very efficient and covers a wide range of area.

articleTitle: A Type-1 Fuzzy Logic Framework for Early Risk Assessment of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Using Clinical Risk Factors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is a condition that can put at risk both mother and fetus but early and proper risk assessment need to be carried out for effective management. This paper discloses a Mamdani-kind Fuzzy Inference System to evaluate GDM risk dependent on clinical parameters like age, parity, glucose levels, body mass index (BMI), and insulin levels. The system can simulate all the numerous risk factors in a more gentle way by the utilization of the triangular membership function that converts accurate clinical data into a fuzzy format. A clear rule base, got from the knowledge maps in the clinical field, is put together from the input data to determining the GDM risk levels. This is neither then defuzzied via the centroid method to generate a determinable score. Results show that this system can be used along with the experts, thus yielding the same results as them, meanwhile, it is capable of providing an intelligible output.
