It lends further credence to the role of fuzzy logic in uncertainties in medical data and their potential by decision support systems in clinical context. While reasonably beneficial results from the system are reported, the static nature of the membership functions implies, for the future, adaptability in methodologies for relative accuracy. This study still emphasizes that fuzzy logic finds application in settings of clinical delineation, which are distinctly more complex for their intended usefulness for conditions such as GDM here.

articleTitle: SmartRecovery: A Deep Learning-Based System for Personalized Post-Cold Recovery Management in Diabetic Patients
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: People with diabetes frequently have a longer and more difficult time recovering from colds because of their weakened immune systems and altered metabolism. An method that is more individualized is required since traditional recovery regimens do not take into consideration lifestyle variables, pharmaceutical interactions, and individual differences in glucose levels. A deep learning-based solution called SmartRecovery is suggested in this study to help diabetics control their post-cold recovery as best they can. The system creates adaptive recovery plans by utilizing multimodal data, such as patient vitals, glucose monitoring, medication adherence, and symptom progression. Using a combination of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for sequential health data analysis and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for pattern recognition, SmartRecovery predicts potential complications and recommends personalized interventions. In order to ensure ongoing evaluation and feedback, the system incorporates real-time monitoring via wearable sensors and mobile health applications. Experimental assessments using actual diabetes patient datasets show how well the suggested strategy works to speed up recovery and reduce dangers to health. A revolutionary approach to post-illness care, SmartRecovery improves patient outcomes and lessens the strain on healthcare systems by utilizing AI-driven insights.

articleTitle: Blockchain for Patient-Centric Solutions Using Distributed Ledger Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Blockchain technology, with its decentralized and tamper-resistant nature, has the potential to revolutionize healthcare by improving data security, reliability, and interoperability. By leveraging encryption methods such as Attribute-Based Encryption (ABE), patient records can be securely stored and protected from unauthorized modifications or breaches. Additionally, the integration of smart contracts and standardized data formats enables seamless communication across diverse healthcare systems, fostering a more connected and efficient ecosystem. This patient-focused model enhances data privacy while granting individuals greater control over their medical information. However, the adoption of blockchain in healthcare encounters several challenges, including regulatory hurdles, scalability issues, implementation costs, and acceptance by users. Moreover, integrating blockchain with existing infrastructures and ensuring cooperation among stakeholders adds further complexity. Despite these obstacles, research underscores blockchain's potential to redefine healthcare data management. Addressing these challenges can pave the way for a more secure, interoperable, and patientdriven healthcare system in the future.

articleTitle: Building a Smart Virtual Chatbot Assistant with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: A virtual chatbot assistant is an interactive application designed to simulate human-like communication and respond to user inquiries promptly. It focuses on building an interesting user interface and putting simple conversational logic into practice; this article presents the development of a chatbot using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Developers can make these fundamental web technologies useful in the creation of accessible and user-friendly chatbot systems for any kind of application. The literature indicates that chatbot technology is under development, which includes the merging of AI and natural language processing to enhance the capabilities of conversations. This handbook is an invaluable tool in making useful chatbots by linking the needs of the users with contemporary online technology.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Smart Agriculture System for Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Increasing demand for environmentally friendly agribusiness has seen the creation of IoT -based intelligent systems, the detection of which is vital for maintaining crop well-being and yielding maximum output. Through measurement of temperature, humidity, and water content in soil, and detection based on image, the system offers insights based on real-time alerts to growers. Its cloud-based, scalable, and modular architecture allows for flexibility for farms of different sizes and extra features like irrigation automation. This solution maximizes efficiency, minimizes environmental footprint, and aids in global food security, fitting within the framework of contemporary precision agriculture.

articleTitle: PredParkinson-MLP: Parkinson Disease Prediction using Multi Layer Perceptron Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Parkinson disease is a neuro generative disorder where patient would be inactive, rigid and have shaky voice due to loss of dopamine production in the brain cell. It is useful for society to detect disease early. Some traditional methods are introduced to do that job. Recently ML algorithms are also used to do the same. Those methods are facing some difficulty like high latency and low accuracy. Our focus is to overcome these problems. We have introduced PredParkinson-MLP to predict parkinson disease along with time estimation. Our dataset consists of 31 people, with 23 positive parkinson disease cases. Performance of our model is compared with other ML algorithms like Decision tree, XGBoost, and SVM. Various performance measurement metrices (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and f1 score) are used to prove enhancement of our model. According to the outcome, our suggested technique beats other existing techniques in terms of accuracy (97.43 %) and precision (96.96 %).

articleTitle: Robotic Arm Manipulator Integration with Commanded Mode Rover for Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of a Robotic arm manipulator integration with commanded mode rover to perform efficient pick-and-place operations in dynamic and uneven terrains. The rover executes three primary tasks such as picking objects using the manipulator, autonomously detecting and avoiding obstacles, and placing objects at designated location with high precision. The rover is controlled via a command-based interface which offers user-friendly operation and adaptability to various environments. The integration of obstacle detection and avoidance, along with robotic arm manipulator control allows the rover to perform tasks remotely from a base station and reliably in challenging conditions. Experimental results validate the rover's performance, highlighting its ability to tackle diverse scenarios with high accuracy and efficiency. This designed rover finds the potential applications in industrial automation, disaster response, and extraterrestrial exploration.

articleTitle: Coordination Frameworks for IoT-Driven Swarm Robotics Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized global device interconnectivity, fostering seamless data exchange through expansive sensing networks. Similarly, swarm robotics emulates the collective behaviors observed in nature, such as bird flocks and ant colonies, aiming to adapt these principles for practical use. This paper explores the dynamics of robotic swarms operating under a centralized network model using master-slave communication. Two implementation approaches are examined: direct, small-scale interactions utilizing device MAC addresses and large-scale connectivity facilitated by an IoT-based cloud server. Our experiments employ the NodeMCU ESP8266 platform, which utilizes the IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi standard for data handling and transfer. For cloud-based communication, we utilize the ThingSpeak server to manage data flow. This study evaluates the strengths and limitations of these approaches in fostering swarm behavior, aiming to derive strategies for enhancing the performance and coordination of swarm robotic systems.

articleTitle: YOLOV9 Driven Internet of Things Enabled Sustainable Solution for Intelligent Traffic Light Management System for Emergency Vehicles in Large Scale Urban Traffic
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Due to densely populated urban environment leads to huge traffic in peak hours, Intelligent traffic light management system becomes paramount for emergency vehicle transportation on leveraging the sensor technologies. However sensor data acquired from densely populated urban environment helps to process the traffic congestion based traffic density. Many researches has been carried out to enable intelligent transportation system using internet of things, artificial intelligence and communication technologies but still it requires sustainable solutions for intelligent transportation., traffic congestion management, traffic light controlling with respect to the detection of emergency vehicles like ambulance as it saves the life of the human being. In this paper, AI driven Intelligent of Things enabled sustainable solutions for intelligent traffic light management system for emergency vehicles in the large scale urban traffic. Initially sensor or camera deployed in the smart cities monitors the roads and its surroundings environments. Those acquired information is transmitted to the base station containing IoT servers. In IoT Server., video data is transformed into image frames and processed using YoloV9 based AI model. YoloV9 Model uses multiple component like backbone., neck and head for processing the image frame to recognize and tack the objects in each frame. Especially Backbone model employs convolution neural network for multi scale feature extraction and feature map generation on inclusion of the Generalized Efficient aggregation Network while neck component uses the path aggregation network for future fusion process and head component uses anchor box bounding box prediction method to detect and recognize the object of interest. On detect of the object of interest, distance and speed of the object is computed using gradient flow. Further model incorporates prediction approaches to detected emergency vehicle to estimate its speed and distance from traffic signal as it helps to control traffic light in signal automatically. Furthermore proposed model eliminates the unwanted traffic congestion caused of ambulance vehicle through prioritizing normal traffic in the urban areas. Experimental analysis of the proposed architecture is carried out as IoT prototype to control the traffic signal for emergency vehicles with Yolo V9based AI model using python programming and OpenCV library files. Performance analysis of the proposed model is carried out with respect to object detection accuracy., throughput and latency. Proposed model provides excellent results compared to state of art approaches.

articleTitle: Intelligent Heart Disease Prediction using Ant Colony Optimization based Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases continue to be the primary cause of death worldwide, responsible for around 31% of all deaths each year, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Although significant progress has been made in their diagnosis and treatment, heart disease remains highly prevalent. It has risen significantly due to unhealthy dietary habits and reduced physical activity. Predicting heart diseases using patient-related data, such as blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and other health metrics, has emerged as one of the most complex tasks for human analysts in modern times. As a result, there is a growing global demand for timely and accurate predictive models in identifying heart disease in healthcare industry, predominantly in the field of cardiology. In this paper, an intelligent heart disease prediction using ant colony optimization using machine learning algorithms is proposed. It includes two phases namely: 1) Feature Selection and 2) Classification. Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) is used to reduce the redundancy in feature selection from the large data set and helps to upgrade the performance of the classifier in the next stage. Then, we exploit the different classification algorithms such as K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost (XGB). These algorithms are chosen for their ability to deliver high accuracy, computational efficiency, and optimized memory usage, making them well-suited for this application. Furthermore, performance of the machine learning algorithms has been evaluated using accuracy, precision, F 1 score, recall and support parameters. The results illustrate that the amalgamation of the ACO algorithm and SVM classifier has the utmost performance for use in heart disease estimation.

articleTitle: Wearable Biosensors: Transformative Innovations and Future Pathways for Continuous Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Wearable biosensors are revolutionizing healthcare by enabling continuous monitoring of health status, transforming it from an event-based process to an ongoing one. When integrated with AI, nanotechnology, and IoMT (Internet of Medical Things), these devices enhance precision care, telediagnosis, and chronic disease management. Advancements in electrochemical, optical, and biochemical sensors, along with innovations in energy harvesting and miniaturized flexible materials, improve both the performance and comfort of these devices. Wearable biosensors are now crucial for everyday fitness, disease prediction, and the seamless exchange of data between m-health apps and EHRs. Despite these advancements, challenges remain, such as data security, system integration, and user incentives. Addressing these concerns through enhanced security features, standardized protocols, and user-focused designs is critical. The future development of wearable biosensors is aimed at leveraging cost-effective energy sources, utilizing AI for data analysis, and improving user convenience, making significant strides in preventive and personalized healthcare.

articleTitle: Prediction of Tuberculosis: A Logistic Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Patients with tuberculosis (TB) often visit a physician without showing specific symptoms. Proper isolation, treatment, and preventive measures are essential to stop the transmission of the disease to others. Logistic regression is widely used statistical method for modeling the relationship between two variables (dependent variable and one or more independent variables), particularly when the outcome is categorical or binary. By applying the logistic (sigmoid) function, it transforms linear combinations of input variables into probabilities, making it ideal for classification tasks. Objectives: This study aims to identify the factors influencing tuberculosis (TB) using a logistic regression prediction model. Methods: This study was conducted in two groups consisting of 105 tuberculosis patients and 105 controls. The risk factors associated with tuberculosis (TB) by comparing a group of TB patients with a control group. By analyzing factors like age, sex, smoking habits, alcohol consumption, diabetic status, and asthma history, the goal seems to be identifying patterns or predictors that could help in understanding who might be at higher risk for developing TB. The use of logistic regression to model these influences and evaluate its predictive accuracy (using sensitivity, specificity, and ROC curve analysis) suggests the researchers are looking to quantify the effectiveness of these factors in predicting TB outcomes. Results: The sensitivity (61%) and specificity (64%) values suggest that the model is moderately effective at distinguishing between cases and non-cases of TB. This study employs a logistic regression model appears to be a solid choice for the prediction of tuberculosis, as indicated by the accuracy and predictive power, along with the area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve of (AUC) of 0.702 indicate that the model is moderately effective at distinguishing between the presence and absence of tuberculosis.

articleTitle: The Digital Revolution in Fashion Discounts: A Study on Coupon Exhange
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This research work proposes the design and application of a novel web site that aims to enrich the online shopping experience through the incorporation of sophisticated data amalgamation, predictive analysis, and dynamic visualization methods. The site consolidates private discounts, minimizes costs, and offers users an effortless and intuitive environment. Most important features, including the Promo Codes system, enable users to transfer or redeem codes, maximally amplifying their saving opportunities. Predictive analytics use past data to predict future promotions, facilitating users in making conscious buying choices. A systematic development methodology, involving user behavior analysis, iterative design, and aggressive testing, guarantees a safe, scalable, and efficient platform. Ongoing performance tracking and maintenance ensure reliability and responsiveness to market trends. With security, flexibility, and real-time insights as top priorities, this platform transforms online shopping, providing an extremely personalized and value-oriented experience for consumers.

Author Keywords: A single platform to find all kinds of offers and exchange unused coupons

articleTitle: The Evolving Role of Telemedicine in Expanding Access to Healthcare: Benefits, Barriers, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Telemedicine, the remote delivery of medical treatment via digital technology has become essential, particularly for rural and disadvantaged populations. The benefits of telemedicine are reviewed in this research, including increased access to care, lower costs, and better chronic illness management. Although the COVID-19 pandemic's acceleration guaranteed continuity of care, technological constraints, legal concerns, and data privacy considerations hindered the full potential from being achieved. The article addresses the barriers to wider adoption and examines research showing the benefits of telemedicine. It ends with suggestions for infrastructure investments and legislative modifications to broaden the use of telemedicine and lessen healthcare inequities.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Online Application for Elegant Farming
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Farmers are under pressure to adapt to modern times and make responsible use of technology in this technologically advanced world. The goal of this much-needed project is to modernize the Indian agriculture supply chain system by addressing numerous issues. This research aims to suggest a user-friendly platform that offers farmers a number of benefits, such as the ability to bargain for fair rates and sell ahead of time before the harvest is ready, protecting it from spoiling and keeping farmers out of trouble during market yard visits. However, this also guarantees jobs in rural areas.

Author Keywords: eNAM - National Agriculture Market (Pan-India electronic trading portal)

articleTitle: Enhanced Bone Crack Detection Using Pretrained CNN Features: A Comparative Analysis of K-Nearest Neighbors and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Bone cracks are the common injuries nowadays, and the graph of injured cases is increasing with time. Detection of disease thru computer is need of hour in all the cases. Telemedicine also needs the support of computers in the detection of such injuries. Various machine learning techniques are evolving and gaining success in a variety of fields. To use a method for a particular application needs a laboratory analysis. This study investigates the efficacy of pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with conventional machine learning classifiers, namely K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Random Forest (RF), for bone crack detection. ResNet-50, we aim to assess the comparative performance of these classifiers in detecting bone cracks from medical imaging datasets. The research explores the accuracy, computational efficiency, and clinical applicability of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Traffic and Pollution Control Using IoT-Enabled Smart Routing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Urbanization has led to increased traffic congestion and air pollution, primarily from vehicle emissions, posing risks to public health and the environment. Existing traffic management systems are inefficient in integrating real-time pollution data, leading to reactive control measures. This project proposes an IoT-based smart traffic management system that integrates real-time air quality monitoring with dynamic traffic control. IoT sensors collect pollution and vehicle data, which is processed using cloud computing and machine learning to optimize traffic flow and reduce emissions. AI techniques provide transparency, helping city authorities understand and trust the system's decisions. The system also offers predictive analytics for proactive pollution management and a user-friendly dashboard for real-time visualization. The solution aims to reduce urban emissions, and enhance traffic efficiency, offering a sustainable approach for modern cities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Utility for Gas/Odor Sensor Signature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Gas/odor sensors are integral components of sensor systems used in diverse applications such as food quality control, environmental monitoring, medical diagnostics, odor profiling, industrial safety, agriculture, explosives detection, wine tasting, pharmaceutical quality control, and toxic gas detection. Traditional approaches in this domain of gas/odor sensing technologies face challenges related to accuracy, cross-sensitivity, and drifted real-time performance. The integration of deep learning techniques with gas sensors has shown promise in overcoming these limitations. Moreover, this amalgamation of gas sensing and deep learning strategies enables accurate identification of gases/odors, handling complex patterns, and leading optimal consumption of resources. In this paper, an overview of advancements in deep learning-enabled gas sensing has been presented that focused on methodologies, sensor types, and applications. This review also highlights the state-of-the-art techniques and identifies gaps for future directions for research.

articleTitle: Vehicle Image Anomaly Detection Based on Improved K-Means Algorithm and High-Resolution Camera
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This study proposes a vehicle image anomaly detection framework based on improved K-means algorithm and high-resolution camera, which provides a new idea for road safety construction from the image processing level. The main innovation of the study contains 4 aspects: 1. A new vehicle target extraction algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. The algorithm uses the YOLOv5s network structure and combines the SimAM attention mechanism to optimize the model while improving the detection accuracy of vehicle targets. 2. A visual-based traffic flow clustering analysis is performed. This analysis achieved effective clustering of traffic flow through deep HOG feature extraction and parallel K-means clustering algorithm. 3. An optimized license plate detection and recognition algorithm based on YOLOv5 is proposed. The algorithm improves the accuracy of license plate recognition by adding the key point detectors. 4. The traditional K-means algorithm is optimized. The optimization idea is mainly to combine quantum computing and space-time theory. This optimization improves the convergence speed and clustering effect of the algorithm. The results of comparative experiments show that the improved K-means algorithm converges faster in traffic flow clustering analysis, and its license plate recognition accuracy is significantly better than traditional algorithms (such as k-means and FCM).

articleTitle: Automatic Identification of the American Sign Language Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Communication is essential, providing a means to express thoughts, emotions, and ideas. Sign language is a fundamental form of communication for those who are deaf, have hearing impairments, or are non-verbal. This research uses machine learning to develop an effective algorithm for identifying the alphabet in American Sign Language (ASL) through natural hand movements. The system combines image processing, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, especially a convolutional neural network (CNN), to translate ASL gestures into accurate and understandable output. After training the model on a dataset that includes sign language images, the results demonstrate the system's ability to identify hand gestures related to the English alphabet accurately.

articleTitle: Generative AI for Cultural Heritage Preservation Using AR and Data Science
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cultural heritage artifacts are invaluable to understanding our shared history and cultural identity. However, these artifacts are increasingly at risk due to aging, environmental factors, activities and humans. This paper explores the integration of Generative AI, augmented reality (AR), and data science in cultural heritage preservation. Generative AI facilitates the restoration of damaged or missing parts of artifacts, while AR provides immersive, interactive experiences, enhancing accessibility and engagement. Data science contributes by analyzing historical and environmental data to inform conservation strategies. This innovative approach demonstrates the potential to transform cultural heritage preservation, ensuring sustainability and accessibility for future generations.

articleTitle: Online Payment Fraud Detection Using Exploratory Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Growing rolls of online transactions have heightened the susceptibility to payment fraud, and these are a problem for both users and financial institutes. In this study, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) is used to detect online payment fraud leveraging Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to find out the hidden patterns, trends, and anomalies in transaction data. Cleaning, visualizing, and analyzing real-world datasets to find the important attributes for determining fraudulent transactions is this methodology. The statistical and graphical techniques are being used to gain insight about the user, the transaction frequency, and some other important aspects. Using these insights, the study demonstrates that EDA can be a strong precursor to predicting relevant features and algorithms for fraud detection. This research is intended to create a basis to create more robust, machine learning-based fraud detection systems that can enable proactive decision- making in financial systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic Tumor Analysis Using Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC) for Personalized Oncology Treatment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Clustering tumors is crucial for comprehending tumor heterogeneity and for personalized treatment approaches. Conventional clustering techniques frequently inadequately represent the intricacies of high-dimensional tumor data. This study utilizes Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC), a sophisticated unsupervised learning method, to categorize tumors according to molecular and clinical characteristics. The collection, obtained from the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) through the Genomic Data Commons (GDC) Portal, comprises 12,000 tumor samples spanning 15 tumor types, including breast, lung, colorectal, prostate, and ovarian cancers, along with attributes such as gene expression and clinical metadata. DEC uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to map high-dimensional data into a lower-dimensional latent space, effectively capturing essential tumor patterns. The samples are subsequently grouped in this space utilizing a clustering objective function that delineates tumor subtypes while preserving the integrity of the data structure. The model is progressively optimized to enhance the embedding and clustering assignments, reducing clustering loss and augmenting classification accuracy. The experimental findings indicate that DEC surpasses conventional approaches, with a clustering accuracy of 92.8%, in contrast to 78.5% for k-means and 81.3% for DBSCAN. The application of t-SNE and UMAP techniques substantiates the biological significance of the detected tumor clusters. Our results underscore the promise of DEC for tumor categorization, providing a means for personalized cancer therapy and predictive oncology.

articleTitle: Medical Prescription Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Precise reading of medical prescriptions is a critical aspect of healthcare administration, directly relating to patient safety and the effectiveness of treatment. Yet, doctors' poor handwriting frequently results in prescription misreading, placing patients at risk of drug errors. To overcome such an issue, this research envisions an automated prescription analysis system based on Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Machine Learning (ML) methodologies. The system is configured to precisely transcribe handwritten prescriptions into structured, readable format, improving access for both pharmacists and patients. The solution proposed in this research study is systematic, encompassing image pre-processing, word segmentation, and smart text recognition, with high precision in reading prescription details. Through incorporating such advanced technologies, the system improves prescription handling efficiency, minimizes medication errors, improves compliance tracking, and personalizes treatment suggestions. Furthermore, its adaptability and scalability allow healthcare organizations to effectively deal with huge prescription volumes, handling varied patient needs. This completely independent application can transform prescription handling, making health care more efficient and improving patient safety.

articleTitle: Eco Collet Mobile Application for the Integral Management of Municipal Solid Waste
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This article presents the development and evaluation of a mobile application designed to optimize municipal solid waste management in Lima, Peru. The application allows citizens to register requests for the collection of recyclable material and municipal workers to document the type and quantity of waste collected, categorized as paper, plastic and glass. In addition, the system provides detailed statistics on recycled material per user, encouraging active participation in the circular economy. As a methodology, the architecture of the system, its implementation, an implementation model is described and as results present that the level of use of the application is above 80% by registered users in a district, as well as in order of recycled material it can be observed that plastic is the material that has been recycled the most, followed by paper and glass in less quantity. As a recommendation, we present that this management methodology for recycling municipal waste can be scaled to biodegradable products, for which an appropriate collection method must be available.

articleTitle: A Novel Visual Communication Scenario Based on Image Processing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In order to comply with the trend of intelligent visual communication, this study proposed an innovative visual communication scenario based on image processing algorithms. The framework aims to optimize traditional key technologies such as the image generation, editing, style transfer and image compression. First, as the foundation of visual communication, this study proposes a generative adversarial network model based on text semantic information for image generation and editing. The model achieves stable image generation and efficient editing from a theoretical level through paired training of text and image pairs. Secondly, for image style transfer, this study designed an improved VGG19 convolutional neural network. At the same time, the adaptive instance normalization technology was combined to optimize the effect of style transfer. Finally, in terms of image compression, the study proposed an improved generative adversarial network (REVISED-GAN) model. This model can dynamically adjust the compression error based on structured information to improve image compression efficiency. Through comparative tests, the proposed image style transfer and image compression algorithms have shown excellent performance in terms of structural similarity, image quality and compression ratio.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Costs With Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The number of SMEs opting for cloud computing rises, efficient utilisation of the cloud has become a crucial issue because of the rental nature of the resources. Current approaches tend to be more traditional, targeting only individual components such as the amount of computing capacity, which may not adequately capture or mitigate the factors that define most actual cloud workloads and their unpredictable behaviour. In light of this, this article presents a new strategy that applies anomaly detection learning algorithms and particle swarm optimization to achieve the right cloud resource configuration at the least cost possible. The suggested idea works independent of a specific context in a loop fashion and distinguishes exceptional cases through an anomaly detection strategy in the loop process and at the same time learns the usage patterns. More importantly, it adapts to changes in system utilisation, as well as the pricing models offered by various cloud providers. Realistic costs as well as system data using the Microsoft Azure proved significant with highlighting 85% costs shaving within 10 months. This research supports the effectiveness of our integrated solution for solving multifaceted issues related to resource management in cloud environments for SMEs.

articleTitle: Automated Crack Detection in Pipelines Using Advanced Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The automated detection of pipeline cracks is vital for maintaining the safety and operational lifespan of this crucial infrastructure. Early crack detection prevents costly repairs and minimizes the risk of catastrophic failures and environmental damage. Existing methods primarily rely on manual inspections and traditional image processing techniques, which often lead to inaccuracies and inefficiencies. These methods suffer from high false-negative rates and poor adaptability to different environmental conditions. This study proposes a deep learning framework utilizing YOLOv10 to automate the detection of pipeline cracks with enhanced accuracy. Studies using deep learning report detection accuracies between 80% and 92%, although performance varies across different studies. The range reflects the influence of factors such as dataset and model specifics.

articleTitle: Open-Source Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as strategic in the promotion of natural language processing (NLP) to the extent of having machines translate languages as well as making logical deductions. The role of the open-source team in advancing this progress is that LLMs are now available for development and research. This paper offers an elaborate literature review on some of the most widely used open-source LLMs and their architecture, training approach, and evaluation results. Certainly, the mathematical aspects behind these models are explored, the comparison of the models is given and the problems and perspectives of development of the models are described.

articleTitle: Efficient Approach to Improve the Security of PDF Readers Using Transfer Learning for Few Shots Sample Scenario
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: PDF malware is a significant threat to computer security. The purpose of this study is to introduce a new approach for improving the security of PDF readers. The method utilizes transfer learning by leveraging existing models and a small number of labeled examples, even with limited training samples. The ResNet34 model has been modified for PDF malware detection by replacing the 2D and 3D channels with a 1D channel. Transfer learning is a technique that is employed to enhance the model by utilizing the labeled samples that are available in a scenario where only a few samples are provided. The evaluation of the PDFMal2022 dataset shows that our approach outperforms existing models. It achieves a detection accuracy of 91.6% on source data and 92.4% on target data. This approach effectively utilizes transfer learning and effectively mitigates the risks associated with PDF malware, thereby offering an improved security solution for PDF readers.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach and its Application in the Cybersecurity Domain
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Cyber Security has become especially prominent and critical for organizations all over the world because of the fast advancements in technology and the increasing sophistication of modern cyber threats. Most traditional methods related to cyber security are unable to match the scale and complexity of modern cyber-attacks. Deep learning has emerged in this context as a powerful tool for offering brand-new approaches and avenues toward threat detection, anomaly identification, and protection of data. In this paper, we investigate the basic principles of deep learning and its significant architectures Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and Generative Adversarial Networks which provide models for solving various issues in the field of cybersecurity. We describe the contribution of deep learning to intrusion detection systems, malware detection, phishing protection, DDoS attack mitigation, and fraud detection. Deep learning also presents some advantages in cybersecurity. In this paper, I reviewed the basic applications, challenges, and potential solutions for enhancing cybersecurity systems by techniques of deep learning. Every organization, right from financial institutes to the entire globe employing itself to reach a developmental stage, has been forced to consider the implications of cybersecurity threats carefully. Most traditional methods relevant to cybersecurity have been ineffective at combatting modern cyber-attacks' scale and complexity.

articleTitle: Classification of Potatoes Using Artificial Intelligence Techniques in High Andean Areas of Peru
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Agriculture is one of the means that provide food to the population, hence the need to improve its performance levels. Thanks to the artificial intelligence and image processing tools that are currently available, it is possible to improve the planting processes of various agricultural products. In Peru, one of the most produced products, both for domestic consumption and for export, are potatoes, in its various classes, so it is necessary to have a tool that can help farmers in their selection processes. In this research we configured a low-pass and power consumption device, such as model 5 of the Raspberry pi embedded card, where the YoloV3 model is configured, which has the ability to recognize different types of potatoes. For the training of the model, a database of 1791 images was configured, training with 80% of the images and validation of the trained model was performed with the remaining 20%. As a result, the sensitivity of the model was 82%, which means that the model can be used as an aid in classification by farmers. In conclusion, it is indicated that the level of sensitivity can be increased by training with a greater number of images and with the increase of potato types, additionally the classification can be configured in recorded video as in the online recording from a camera, for which performance levels can be selected in terms of the probability of success in the classification.

articleTitle: Enhanced and Effective Model for Heart Disease Prediction Using Hybridization of Random Forest and AdaBoost (HRFAB)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Coronary artery disease or heart disease is the leading cause of death worldwide. In the field of data analysis and clinical decision making, one of the challenging tasks is the prediction of heart disease. In today's era, large amount of data is getting generated and Machine learning is able to analyse, predict this data. We have studied ML techniques which are mostly used in medical field. In this view, various research techniques have been conducted by researchers using ML classifiers. In this paper, we have implemented a good ensemble & bagging and boosting techniques i.e. Random Forest and AdaBoost respectively to predict the heart disease. To generate prediction model, data preprocessing techniques are applied on well-known dataset extended Z Alizadeh Sani. We achieved 95% prediction accuracy for hybrid of Random Forest and AdaBoost model (HRFAB). It gave us better accuracy for heart disease forecast.

articleTitle: Multi Task Learning Architecture for Vehicle Detection and Vehicle Tracking Towards Passenger Safety and Traffic Violations Detection Using Pairing Net and Fast Yolo Rec Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Nowadays, Traffic violation is becoming serious challenges to the government and insurance agencies as it results danger to their life or other life's. Especially two-wheeler vehicle leads to primary and big concern against traffic violations involving bike racing, carrying more than two passengers, driving without helmets, lane changes. Many manual fining system has been imposed against violators against the road safety still many incident occurring during absence of the traffic monitoring polices. In order to prevent the traffic violations automatically, high strength traffic violation monitoring and detection system has to be integrated with automatic fining system. In this paper, multitask learning architecture for monitoring, detection and preventing the two-wheeler vehicle passenger safety and traffic violations is developed along automated violation fine ticketing system using Graph Convolution l Network and Fast Yolo Rec techniques. Proposed architecture is capable of detecting the persons not wearing the helmet, wearing helmet improperly, bike racing, lane changing and triple ridding to impose the automatic traffic and safety violation fine ticketing on identifying vehicle number plate details using number plate recognition system. Initially proposed architecture handles the acquired video from the real monitoring system or extracting video from coco dataset which is considered as benchmark dataset for intelligent transportation systems developments. Extracted video is transformed into image frames. Those Image frames were processed using convolution Neural Network for segmentation and feature extraction on the convolution and fully connected layers of the model and those extracted feature were employed to detection using Fast Yolo Rec approach. Fast Yolo Rec approach is object recognition mechanism which is capable of detecting multiple objects in a single frame within short period. Fast Yolo Rec is capable of producing bounding box around the object of interest. Fast Yolo Rec architecture composed of ResNet as backbone which contains CNN layers with receptive fields, PANet as path aggregation neck and head. ResNet is employed to process the extracted the feature and map those feature related to number plate and no of riders to the specified vehicles in the particular frame. However, neck is utilized for feature mapping of various positions related to helmet usage and no of riders. Finally, head is utilized for detection of helmet use and no of passenger in the particular vehicle. Automated ticket fining is carried out on detection of abnormality on the specified vehicle. Proposed architecture is experimented and evaluated with respect to detection accuracy, average precision and frames per second on detecting the no of riders, helmet use of monitored vehicle. Experimental results prove that proposed architecture provides better results compared to conventional approaches on accuracy and efficiency on processing road safety related information.

articleTitle: Contextualized Autonomous Drone Navigation Using LLMs Deployed in Edge-Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Autonomous navigation is usually trained offline in diverse scenarios and fine-tuned online subject to real-world experiences. However, the real world is dynamic and changeable, and many environmental encounters/effects are not accounted for in real-time due to difficulties in describing them within offline training data or hard to describe even in online scenarios. However, we know that the human operator can describe these dynamic environmental encounters through natural language, adding semantic context. The research is to deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform real-time contextual code adjustment to autonomous navigation. The challenge not evaluated in literature is what LLMs are appropriate and where should these computationally heavy algorithms sit in the computation-communication edge-cloud computing architectures. In this paper, we evaluate how different LLMs can adjust both the navigation map parameters dynamically (e.g., contour map shaping) and also derive navigation task instruction sets. We then evaluate which LLMs are most suitable and where they should sit in future edge-cloud of 6G telecommunication architectures.

articleTitle: Comparison of SVM and Random Forest for Detection of Malicious Node in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are used in various contexts and offer a wide range of applications, despite being a decentralized, resource-scarce network type; this is why this study deals with the problem of malicious nodes. Identifying such nodes is important to preventing the compromise of the network and all the nodes in it. In this paper, a comparative study of two popular classifiers named Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF) in order to detect hostile nodes in WSNs. By nature, a malicious node in a network will cause significant problems to the users. There are number of models also there to detect the malicious node. Based on the above-discussed parameters the paper compares these algorithms in terms of detection accuracy, computational complexity, scalability and performance measure of imbalanced data. The comparison draws on different targets such as accuracy, capacity/large scale, speed, and small sample imbalance, and noise. As stated in this paper, both SVM and Random Forest have its own strengths where the selection between them mainly depends on the network environment and the features of the malicious activity.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Malicious URLs in Twitter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The objective of this research is to develop a machine learning system on Twitter suitable for detecting malicious URLs. The system categorizes URLs transmitted across the network, in order to identify possible threats such as phishing and malware. This methodology use machine learning algorithms to analyze URL properties and predict their possible influence. Through the rapid identification of hazardous URLs, the system can implement proactive strategies to deter users from accessing them, so enhancing the security of the Twitter ecosystem. The main objectives are to protect consumers from any hazards and enhance the reliability of online contacts. The suggested methodology employs sophisticated machine learning algorithms such as random forest (RF) and logistic regression (LR) to accurately detect fraudulent URLs in online social networks. These algorithms have demonstrated a high level of effectiveness in classification tasks, especially when handling complicated and extensive information associated with URL-based threats.

articleTitle: Synchrophasor Deployment on ICI System to Detect Faulty Line Unobservability
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) based continuous supervision of electric power grid components has a great contribution in widespread power grid monitoring as per the security and reliability is concern. Moreover, Intentional Controlled Islanding (ICI) is a common strategy adopted by system operators to operate the power grid efficiently. In this paper, Modified Symbiotic Organism Search (MSOS) has been proposed to deploy the PMUs optimally for healthy operating condition as well as intentional controlled islanding mode. Complete observability is satisfied by the proposed method for both of the operating mode. The proposed method has been extended to detect the faulty line unobservability after optimal deployment of PMU. This efficient method has been applied on IEEE standard test systems- 14 bus, 30 bus and 118 bus, to test the efficacy of it.

articleTitle: How AI in Life Insurance can Revolutionize Public Health: A Proactive Approach to Wellness and Disease Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The growing field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is penetrating deeper into the soul of healthcare, especially in the field of remote patient monitoring and telemedicine, bringing a paradigm shift. AI is improving the quality of service while also giving patients more power and promoting a more collaborative relationship between providers and their patients through the utilization of technologies such as virtual assistant chatbots, wearable monitoring devices, predictive analytical models, custom treatment and monitoring plans, and wireless appointment scheduling systems. However, this gradual embedding of AI into the healthcare domain brings with it a host of challenges that have never been faced before. As the life insurance industry evolves, technology is taking on a more prominent role in shaping how insurers interact with their policyholders. As we approach the year 2030, Artificial Intelligence (AI) is expected to be an integral part of life insurance strategies, particularly in terms of personalized and proactive health initiatives that not only enhance life outcomes for policyholders but also support the long-term profitability of insurance carriers. This paper explores the ways in which AI can be used to develop proactive health programs that promote healthier living, prevent chronic diseases, and improve customer engagement in the life insurance industry.

articleTitle: Electronics and Renewable Systems Guided Water Resource Measurement Optimization Analysis with Smart Hardware
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Water resources are important natural resources for the survival and development of human society. Therefore, in the context of strengthening groundwater resource management and protection at the global level, how to save and manage water resources from an intelligent perspective is an important research direction. In this study, the new paradigm for water resource measurement and integrated optimization analysis of smart hardware is proposed. In terms of theoretical architecture, this system paradigm combines IoT technology, smart water meters, low-power wide area network (LoRa) communication algorithms, and smart devices for water resource monitoring data collection to form a complete system. The system can realize real-time collection and long-distance wireless transmission of data such as water quantity, water quality, and water pressure. In the experimental part, this study focused on the packet loss rate (PLR) test of the LoRa communication system, and evaluated the communication effect of the system in a low-power, long-distance, and non-wiring environment. The experimental results show that during the sending and receiving of 100,000 data packets, the packet loss rate of module A is 1.05%, and the packet loss rate of module B is 1.17%. This shows that through the intelligent hardware water resources measurement paradigm proposed in this study, relevant institutions can effectively improve the monitoring accuracy of water resources.

articleTitle: Integration of Blockchain Technology, International Trade and Information Security: A Systematic Study
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain and related information security technologies, system integration combining international trade and information security has become a research focus of the modern international trade system. Therefore, this study proposes a new framework to address the challenges of information security and identity authentication in cross-border transactions. The proposed framework consists of four main branches: 1) Sybil attack and defense technology. The designed algorithm detects and prevents interference from malicious nodes by optimizing the algorithm; 2) Cross-border transaction information security. This module uses digital signature technology based on polarization code to ensure the security and privacy of cross-border transaction data to the greatest extent; 3) Decentralized identity authentication. The decentralized identity management system based on blockchain in this verification model can effectively avoid single point failures, thereby improving user data security; 4) Supply chain management blockchain. This architecture uses blockchain technology to ensure the data credibility and information openness of the cross-border e-commerce supply chain. Experimental results show that the proposed method has significantly improved the overall registration accuracy in terms of preventing Sybil attacks, ensuring information security and improving supply chain management.

articleTitle: Bimodal Biometric Human Recognition System Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Biometric recognition system combining two or more traits is a method of identifying human using deep learning techniques. Protection is the primary issue for humans nowadays. Biometric human identification system using single trait may not be accurate due to inconsistencies in the captured data, making system more vulnerable to spoofing or hacking and also sensitive to environmental conditions. Recently, Multimodal biometric techniques help mitigate these issues by providing high security and more accuracy. This research work combines two traits such as iris and palm print to encounter the growing demand for high precision in today's biometric system known as Bimodal Biometric system. Bimodal systems are working to extend the high performance which will not be possible using single trait. This paper reviews the background of iris and palm print, then apply preprocessing techniques to remove noise and classification using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for human identification.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Wearable Sensor-Driven Human Activity Recognition for Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In the recent past, due to the availability of data from Wearable Sensors and Smart Phones at lower cost with energy efficiency, recognizing and tracking uncharacteristic behavior particularly in elderly people has become focal point in research. In addition, there exists more than 962 million aged people globally and 1 in 6 people will be aged 60 years or over by 2030. Thus, in this paper, we aim to analyze and assist elderly people in performing daily activities using wearable sensor data, considering the decline in both physical activity and mental abilities due to aging factor. To achieve this, monitoring elderly people's daily activities in indoor environments via wearable sensors data is essential. Machine Learning algorithms like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, and Random Forest are utilized for activity recognition using the data collected from wearable sensors. These algorithms are chosen to handle timestamped data and for their ability to deliver high accuracy, and optimized memory usage, making them well-suited for this application. Furthermore, performance of three machine learning algorithms has been evaluated using accuracy, precision, F1 score, recall and support parameters. Among all the techniques tested, the SVM accomplished superior accuracy, achieving 96.34 %, followed by Random Forest at 92.67%, and Decision Tree with 85.57%.

articleTitle: Advancement in Early-Stage Detection and Treatment of Endometrial Cancer: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Nowa days health sector getting more advancement in diagnosis disease in early stages. Early detection and early-stage treatment plays an important role in detection of endometrial cancer in women. However, so many traditional screening and classification methods are available to diagnose the endometrial cancer but have limited capacity to diagnose, by implementing deep learning technique in classifying stages will results with high accuracy. This paper reviews about different stages of endometrial cancer and diagnostic tools, future direction for research.

articleTitle: Leveraging Neural Networks for Accurate Diagnosis of Eye Diseases in Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The study investigates a no-code methodology utilizing Orange software to classify preprocessed retinal fundus images into four distinct categories: Normal, Diabetic Retinopathy, Cataract, and Glaucoma. The dataset, consisting of 4216 retinal images, underwent feature extraction using the VGG16 deep learning model. A series of neural network configurations were tested, incorporating 12 different combinations of activation functions (Identity, Logistic, Tanh, ReLU)and optimization solvers (L-BFGS-B, SGD, Adam). To evaluate model performance, several metrics were employed, including Area Under the Curve (AUC), classification accuracy (CA), F1-score, precision, recall, and specificity. The best results were obtained using the ReLU and Tanh activation functions combined with the Adam solver, which achieved an AUC of 0.968, CA of 0.85, F1-score of 0.85, precision of 0.85, recall of 0.85, and specificity of 0.951. These results highlight the effectiveness of no-code platforms, such as Orange, in medical image classification tasks, underscoring their potential for accessible, efficient, and high-performing solutions in medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Face Authentication System for Web and Native Apps
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In a period where security breaches and password-related issues are prevalent, the demand for more secure and user-friendly authentication methods has become paramount. This paper introduces a novel approach to web application authentication using facial recognition technology. The system allows users to register and log in to the web app using their unique facial features, offering a secure and convenient alternative to traditional password-based authentication methods. Through the integration of facial detection and recognition algorithms, coupled with a user-friendly interface, this paper aims to provide a seamless and robust authentication experience for users across various platforms.

articleTitle: Optimizing Blockchain Mining Decisions Using Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Blockchain technology is a distributed database that records the transactions across a network of computers. Blockchain technology ensures security and transparency of the data. Blockchain mining refers to the process of verifying the transactions in a blockchain network. However, blockchain mining consumes high energy and solving complex mathematical problems and puzzles. We this study addressed these challenges of blockchain mining using Reinforcement Learning (RL). We have developed a custom environment, BlockchainMiningEnv using openAIGym framework. This environment specifies key factors of blockchain mining like difficulty level and energy cost. These are used to create a realistic model for training an intelligent agent. The agent is trained with algorithms like proximal policy optimizing (PPO) Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Advantage Actor-Critic(A2C) to learn how to deal with these computational resources. The main aim of the agent is to maximize rewards by increasing mining efficiency and minimizing the energy consumption. In this paper we have combined blockchain technology with Reinforcement Learning (RL) to improve efficiency and sustainability of blockchain mining by maintaining the security and transparency of the data.

articleTitle: Time Series Forecasting with Hybrid SARIMA
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Forecasting is an important task in any organization so that they can predict the targets and modify their strategies in order to improve their productivity of sales for the upcoming future. This paper primarily deals about the prediction of products for sales. The focus has been mainly on forecasting techniques like SARIMA and it is optimized using a gradient boosting algorithm to improve the prediction rate. The dataset that has been used for current predictions is a source from Kaggle. The data comprises of both linear and non-linear data to simulate the real time sales.

articleTitle: Real-Time Testing of Soil Qualities using Raspberry PI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Soil fertility plays a vital role in the soil's capacity to support plant growth. It is assessed through various factors, including macro and micro nutrients, water content, and pH levels. Each harvest depletes soil nutrients, necessitating their replenishment, often through the use of fertilizers. Farmers typically estimate the required fertilizer amounts, but applying too much or too little can negatively impact plant health and lower yields. Although soil testing is a common practice for monitoring nutrient levels, it can be time-consuming and yield inconsistent results between laboratory tests and field conditions. To address these issues, a new soil testing tool with temperature, color, and pH sensors provides real-time information on soil parameters like temperature, pH, and color. This tool offers a more precise and effective substitute for conventional soil testing techniques.

articleTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Global Review of Analysis, Intervention and Support Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a multifaceted neurodevelopmental disorder with difficulties in social communication, behavior, and sensory processing. The worldwide prevalence has risen, calling for inclusive diagnostic strategies, efficient interventions, and firm support systems. This paper presents a worldwide review of the up-to-date global state of ASD diagnosis, intervention, and support strategies. It investigates diagnostic criteria and methods among nations, emphasizing inequalities in access to early diagnosis and culturally appropriate assessment tools. The review also examines a range of intervention models, such as behavioral therapies, education programs, and drug interventions, assessing their effectiveness and limitations. The review also discusses support measures for people with ASD and their families, with emphasis on community-based programs, government policy, and the health professional's role. Drawing upon convergent cross-cultural insights from varied global perspectives, this research paper seeks to advise future intervention and promote greater inclusivity to global understanding regarding ASD, pleading the case for more awareness, earlier intervention, and continued assistance across society.

articleTitle: VitaAir- Breathable Air in Processing Plants Using Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Ensuring clean air and safety in industrial and confined spaces, this project introduces a cutting-edge air quality monitoring system that combines the capabilities of MQ135 and MQ136 gas sensors with an ESP32 microcontroller. The MQ135 sensor detects multiple pollutants, including CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and benzene, while the MQ136 specializes in H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S monitoring. Data collected by the ESP32 is transmitted to Node-RED for dynamic visualization and storage, enabling real-time tracking of air quality. Customizable thresholds for each gas trigger immediate email and voice alerts upon hazardous levels. Featuring a easy to use dashboard and automated logging, this system offers an innovative solution for proactive air quality management and enhanced safety.

articleTitle: Smart Sanitation Management: Integrating IoT, AI-Driven Analytics, and Automated Sensing for Efficient Public Toilet Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: An IoT-based self-sustained public toilet maintenance system aims to improve hygiene, efficiency, and resource management. It integrates smart sensors, microcontrollers, and cloud connectivity to monitor parameters such as water levels, air quality, and toilet usage in real-time. AI-driven predictive maintenance optimizes cleaning schedules, minimizes downtime, and ensures efficient resource use. Automated water control prevents wastage, while air quality sensors detect harmful gases and activate ventilation. A smart notification system alerts municipal authorities about supply shortages, enabling timely replenishment of water, soap, and tissues. By reducing manual intervention, the system lowers operational costs and improves service quality. Cloud connectivity allows seamless data processing, offering insights for better sanitation management. The integration of IoT and AI ensures proactive maintenance responses. A comparative analysis highlights the novelty of this system in automating and optimizing maintenance.

articleTitle: Development of a Health Prediction and Assistance System using ANN and T5-Small Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In this work, ANN and the T5-Small model are proposed for constructing a health prediction model and a chatbot for health support. The parameters adopted by the ANN model to determine the health of an individual were based on the daily activities, occupation, sleep pattern, and other activities. Through the ability of ANN to capture complicated patterns and combinations, there is always an improvement of classification. Furthermore, fine-tuning also helped with gaining better insight of the data and the connections between the data, which are considered to be more complex. The system was on a local computer and the Arizona version was on the same machine for testing and modifications. The T5-Small model was used to teach the chat assistant what kind of health problems can occur and when it is better to consult with special consultants. This work provides a useful and effective approach to TPH, focusing on individual, accurate, and useful prediction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Battery Durability: Early Life Cycle Prediction Through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: In this paper, the battery life using Machine Learning Algorithms was predicted using MATLAB Software. Early and accurate predictions are important for electric vehicles, electronics, and energy storage. Traditional methods need a lot of real-time data, leading to inefficiencies. This article uses machine learning to predict battery performance early, based on factors like temperature, voltage, and current during initial charge-discharge cycles. Mechanisms such as Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, SVM, as well as Neural Networks, are tested with historical battery data to find patterns of degradation. The study also explores how well these models work for different types of batteries.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resource Allocation Framework with Advanced Technologies for Enhanced 5G Mobile Network Performances
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: The 5G networks are capable of executing a wide range of applications. Some of these applications are improved mobile broadband, massive Machine Type Communications (mMTC), and ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC). In order to satisfy these requirements adequately, resource management is essential. This work develops an approach of dynamic resource allocation with an emphasis on the use of cutting-edge technologies like edge computing, network slicing, AI, and ML for 5G enhancement. The system ensures dynamic resource allocation strategies which are aimed at reducing the service latency, conserving energy and improving the throughput of the system. This is done by leveraging user requests, real-time traffic patterns, and service quality indicators. The reduction in end-to-end latency of 25%, a 30% increase in energy efficiency and improved diversity of resource application are some of the quantitative improvements on QoS metrics that were achieved. Through simulations, the benefits were demonstrated. The results of this study suggest that the growing complexity of today's communication networks could be addressed by processes that are adaptive to the dynamics of advanced technologies.

articleTitle: Auris Guardian - A Smartphone Application for Hearing Loss Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Hearing loss is a common problem world over, which often resulted in reduced communication skills and quality of life. Conventionally, tests were carried out by the audiologists on the patient after equipping him with precise audiometers, and it was expensive, inaccessible, and time consuming as well, especially in less fortunate health resource regions. Therefore, for this, applications have been developed on the smartphones to diagnose hearing losses using air-conduction pure-tone audiometry techniques. This project evaluates the validity and reliability of such applications, particularly their performance in the event of using the “10 dB down and 5 dB up” method to hear threshold detection. The paper extends into the design and realization of an audiometric testing application based on advanced audio signal processing algorithms to diagnose hearing loss. Some smartphone apps have demonstrated the ability to achieve up to 90% precision in identifying mild hearing loss compared to the standard audiological tests. However, inconsistencies are possible due to varying device quality, earphone calibrations, and background noise. The new system combines data acquisition along with handling audio inputs, interaction with the user, and data analysis to ascertain hearing loss more accurately. Such applications may serve as low-cost, user-friendly alternatives to traditional audiology and facilitate hearing tests even in remote locations or among those not accessible to the audiologists.

articleTitle: Graph Augmentation-based Large Language Models for Movie Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: Personalized movie recommendations are essential for enhancing user engagement and satisfaction in streaming platforms, yet traditional methods like collaborative filtering often struggle with capturing complex user-item interactions. This study introduces a novel framework integrating graph augmentation techniques with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve recommendation accuracy and relevance. The framework generates graph-enhanced embeddings by constructing a user-item graph enriched with metadata such as user preferences, movie genres, cast details, and interaction histories and applying graph augmentation techniques like node feature enrichment and edge transformations. These embeddings are integrated into pretrained LLMs, such as GPT or BERT, which are fine-tuned to provide contextualized recommendations. The method optimizes for multiple objectives, including accuracy, diversity, and novelty, ensuring a balanced and personalized experience. Experiments on datasets like MovieLens and Netftix Prize demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms traditional methods and standalone LLMs, significantly improving precision, recall, and ranking metrics. Despite challenges related to scalability and dependency on high-quality graph data, this framework highlights the potential of combining graph augmentation and LLMs to advance personalized recommendation systems. This research offers a transformative pathway for enhancing the quality and context-awareness of recommendations in the entertainment domain.

articleTitle: The Utilization of Google Cloud in the Healthcare Industry
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This essay's primary focus is on Google Cloud's use in healthcare and how it affects data management, teamwork, and cost-effectiveness. With a focus on Google Cloud, which improves the processing, storing, and accessibility of medical data, the study examines the trends, advantages, and persistent challenges that come with the increasing usage of cloud computing technology. These consist of remote patient monitoring, “artificial intelligence,” and “machine learning” applications in diagnostics, diagnostics, and personalized medicine. Data privacy, security issues, and concerns with the HIPAA incident are among the problems that are discussed along with all the significant elements that could facilitate the cloud migration of healthcare.

articleTitle: Autonomous Driver Distraction Identification using the YOLO Algorithm in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Machine Learning and Autonomous Systems (ICMLAS)
abstract: This research work proposes a novel approach to driver distraction detection using the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection algorithm combined with a convolutional neural network (CNN). The proposed model comprises two main stages: object detection employing the YOLO and categorization for identifying objects. This algorithm is utilized for detect and locate various objects in the driver's environment, including the driver's face, hands, and other potential distractions. Following this, a CNN classifies the detected objects to ascertain whether the driver is distracted. The proposed model is evaluated using a public dataset and demonstrates high accuracy in detecting driver distraction. This method has the potential for integration into advanced driver assistance systems, thereby improving road safety in real-time environments.
